pairs.english: And you shall present a fire-offering, a burnt-offering to the L-rd, two young bullocks [(in commemoration of the bullock of Abraham (Genesis 18:7)], one ram [(in commemoration of the ram of Isaac (Ibid. 22:13)],

pairs.hebrew: וְשִׁבְעָ֤ה כְבָשִׂים֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: and seven one-year-old lambs [(in commemoration of Jacob (Ibid. 30:40)]; unblemished shall they be to you.
And their meal-offering, flour mixed with oil,

pairs.hebrew: שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֗ר וּשְׁנֵ֧י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֛ים לָאַ֖יִל תַּעֲשֽׂוּ׃
pairs.english: three esronim for the bullock and two esronim for the ram shall you offer it.
Issaron, issaron shall you offer for the one lamb,
for the seven lambs.
And one kid as a sin-offering
to atone for you.

pairs.hebrew: מִלְּבַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַבֹּ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֑יד
pairs.english: Aside from the burnt-offering of the morning of the daily burnt-offering
shall you offer these.

pairs.hebrew: כָּאֵ֜לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֤וּ לַיּוֹם֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים לֶ֛חֶם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ־נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהֹוָ֑ה
pairs.english: As these shall you offer each day [(They are not to decrease progressively as the bullocks of Succoth)] for seven days, the food of a fire-offering, a sweet savor to the L-rd;
in addition to the continual burnt-offering shall it be offered, and its libation.
And on the seventh day, a calling of holiness shall it be for you;
all work of labor you shall not do.

pairs.hebrew: וּבְי֣וֹם הַבִּכּוּרִ֗ים בְּהַקְרִ֨יבְכֶ֜ם מִנְחָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה בְּשָׁבֻעֹ֖תֵיכֶ֑ם מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם
pairs.english: And on the day of first-fruits [(Shavuoth is designated as the "first" of the wheat harvest (Exodus 34:22) by reason of the two loaves (Leviticus 23:17), the first of the wheaten meal-offerings brought from the new grain)], when you offer a new meal-offering to the L-rd in (the completion of) your weeks (see Leviticus 23:15), a calling of holiness shall it be for you;
all work of labor you shall not do.
And you shall present a burnt-offering, as a sweet savor to the L-rd,

pairs.hebrew: פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד שִׁבְעָ֥ה כְבָשִׂ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃
pairs.english: two young bullocks, one ram, and seven one-year-old lambs.

pairs.hebrew: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֔ד
pairs.english: And their meal-offering: flour mixed with oil, three esronim for the one bullock,
two esronim for the one ram.
Issaron, issaron for the one lamb,
for the seven lambs.
One kid of goats
to atone for you.
Aside from the continual burnt-offering and its meal-offering shall you offer (them).
Unblemished shall they be for you, and their libations. [Their libations, too, shall be unblemished — whence it is derived that mouldy wine is invalid.]

pairs.hebrew: וּבַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם
pairs.english: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be unto you a calling of holiness.

pairs.hebrew: כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ י֥וֹם תְּרוּעָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: All work of labor you shall not do; a day of teruah (blowing the shofar) shall it be for you.
And you shall offer a burnt-offering as a sweet savor to the L-rd:

pairs.hebrew: פַּ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃
pairs.english: one young bullock, one ram, seven one-year-old lambs, unblemished.

pairs.hebrew: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר
pairs.english: And their meal-offering: flour mixed with oil, three esronim for the bullock,
two esronim for the ram.
And one issaron for the one lamb,
for the seven lambs.
And one kid of goats
to atone for you.

pairs.hebrew: מִלְּבַד֩ עֹלַ֨ת הַחֹ֜דֶשׁ וּמִנְחָתָ֗הּ וְעֹלַ֤ת הַתָּמִיד֙ וּמִנְחָתָ֔הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶ֖ם כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם
pairs.english: Aside from the burnt-offering of the month [the mussafim of Rosh Chodesh of Rosh Hashanah] and its meal-offering and the continual burnt-offering and its meal-offering, and their libations as prescribed,
as a sweet savor, a fire-offering to the L-rd.

pairs.hebrew: וּבֶעָשׂוֹר֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י הַזֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם וְעִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת־נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: And on the tenth (day) of this seventh month, a calling of holiness shall there be for you, and you shall afflict your souls;
all labor you shall not do.
And you shall present a burnt-offering to the L-rd, a sweet savor,

pairs.hebrew: פַּ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֤ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָה֙ שִׁבְעָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: one young bullock, one ram, seven one-year-old lambs; unblemished shall they be to you.

pairs.hebrew: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַפָּ֔ר
pairs.english: And their meal-offering: flour mixed with oil, three esronim for the bullock,
two esronim for the one ram.
Issaron, issaron for the one lamb,
for the seven lambs.
One kid of goats as a sin-offering,

pairs.hebrew: מִלְּבַ֞ד חַטַּ֤את הַכִּפֻּרִים֙ וְעֹלַ֣ת הַתָּמִ֔יד וּמִנְחָתָ֖הּ וְנִסְכֵּיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
pairs.english: aside from the sin-offering of atonement [the goat offered within the holy of holies (Leviticus 16:9)] and the continual burnt-offering and its meal-offering [shall you offer these burnt-offerings], and [you shall offer] their libations [those of the aforementioned mussafim (8)].

pairs.hebrew: וּבַחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י מִֽקְרָא־קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָכֶ֔ם כׇּל־מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ
pairs.english: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, a calling of holiness shall there be for you; all work of labor you shall not do,
and you shall celebrate a festival to the L-rd, seven days.

pairs.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה
pairs.english: And you shall present a burnt-offering, a fire-offering, a sweet savor to the L-rd,

pairs.hebrew: פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי־שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיֽוּ׃
pairs.english: thirteen young bullocks, two rams, fourteen one-year-old lambs; unblemished shall they be.

pairs.hebrew: וּמִ֨נְחָתָ֔ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַשָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַפָּ֣ר הָֽאֶחָ֗ד לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ פָּרִ֔ים
pairs.english: And their meal-offering: flour mixed with oil, three esronim for the one bullock, for the thirteen bullocks,

pairs.hebrew: שְׁנֵ֤י עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לָאַ֣יִל הָֽאֶחָ֔ד לִשְׁנֵ֖י הָאֵילִֽם׃
pairs.english: two esronim for the one ram, for the two rams.
And issaron, issaron for the one lamb,
for the fourteen lambs.
And one kid of goats for a sin-offering,
aside from the continual burnt-offering, its meal-offering, and its libation.

pairs.hebrew: וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשֵּׁנִ֗י פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי־בָקָ֛ר שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
pairs.english: And on the second day, twelve young bullocks, two rams,
fourteen one-year-old lambs, unblemished.
And their meal-offering and their libations: for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs,

according to their number, as prescribed. [The seventy bullocks of the Succoth festival correspond to the seventy nations, their progressive diminution during the festival alluding to the ultimate destruction of the nations. The lambs correspond to Israel, which is called "a scattered lamb" (Jeremiah 50:17). Their number is fixed, and their total (ninety-eight) alludes to their serving to avert the ninety-eight curses of the book of Deuteronomy. The three variant letters (mem in veniskeihem (19), yod in unesachehah (31), and mem in kemishpatam (33), spell out "mayim" (water), an allusion to the water libation on Succoth.)]
And one kid of goats for a sin-offering,
aside from the continual burnt-offering and its meal-offering and their libations.

pairs.hebrew: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עַשְׁתֵּי־עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
pairs.english: And on the third day, eleven bullocks, two rams,
fourteen one-year-old lambs, unblemished.
And their meal-offering and their libations: for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs,
according to their number, as prescribed.
And one kid for a sin-offering,
aside from the continual burnt-offering and its meal-offering and its libation.

pairs.hebrew: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עֲשָׂרָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
pairs.english: And on the fourth day, ten bullocks, two rams,
fourteen one-year-old lambs, unblemished.
Their meal-offering and their libations: for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs,
according to their number, as prescribed.
And one kid of goats for a sin-offering,
aside from the continual burnt-offering, its meal-offering, and its libation.

pairs.hebrew: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַחֲמִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים תִּשְׁעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
pairs.english: And on the fifth day, nine bullocks, two rams,
fourteen one-year-old lambs, unblemished.
And their meal-offering and their libations: for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs,
according to their number, as prescribed.
And one kid for a sin-offering,
aside from the continual burnt-offering and its meal-offering and its libation.

pairs.hebrew: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשִּׁשִּׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שְׁמֹנָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
pairs.english: And on the sixth day, eight bullocks, two rams,
fourteen one-year-old lambs, unblemished.
And their meal-offerings and their libations: for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs,
according to their number, as prescribed.
And one kid for a sin-offering,
aside from the continual burnt-offering, its meal-offering, and its libations.

pairs.hebrew: וּבַיּ֧וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שִׁבְעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם
pairs.english: And on the seventh day, seven bullocks, two rams,
fourteen one-year-old lambs, unblemished.
And their meal-offering and their libations: for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs,
according to their number, as prescribed for them.
And one kid for a sin-offering,
aside from the continual burnt-offering, its meal-offering, and its libation.
On the eighth day, a withholding [from work] shall there be for you;
all work of labor you shall not do.

pairs.hebrew: וְהִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה
pairs.english: And you shall present a burnt-offering, a fire-offering, a sweet savor to the L-rd,

pairs.hebrew: פַּ֥ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי־שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם׃
pairs.english: one bullock, one ram, seven one-year-old lambs, unblemished. [These ("one bullock, etc.") vis-à-vis Israel, the L-rd, as it were, telling His children before they depart from Him: "Abide with Me yet another day."]
Their meal-offering and their libations: for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs,
according to their number, as prescribed.
And one kid for a sin-offering,
aside from the continual burnt-offering, and its meal-offering and its libation.
These [fixed offerings] shall you offer to the L-rd on your festivals,

pairs.hebrew: לְבַ֨ד מִנִּדְרֵיכֶ֜ם וְנִדְבֹתֵיכֶ֗ם לְעֹלֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ וּלְמִנְחֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וּלְנִסְכֵּיכֶ֖ם וּלְשַׁלְמֵיכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: aside from your vows and your gift-offerings [(If you wish to offer such on the festival, it is "a mitzvah come to hand"; or, your vows or gift-offerings pledged during the year — offer them on the festival (lest you find it difficult to return and offer them and be in transgression of (Deuteronomy 23:22): "You shall not delay, etc.")] for your burnt-offerings, and your meal-offerings, and your libations, and your peace-offerings.
And Moses related (it) to the children of Israel,
as all that the L-rd had commanded Moses, [viz. 28:2 (This is stated here to obviate the impression that Moses did not tell it to them but proceeded directly to the section that follows.)]

pairs.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־רָאשֵׁ֣י הַמַּטּ֔וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר
pairs.english: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel [(according them honor by instructing them first, and then instructing the children of Israel (this being stated here specifically in respect to vows though it was the mode for all teachings (see Exodus 34:31-32), in order to teach that the annulment of vows is effected by one expert (in vows), or, in his absence, by three non-experts)], saying:
This is the thing that the L-rd has commanded.
A man, if he vow a vow to the L-rd [(not to eat something or not to do something)],
or if he take an oath to bind a bond upon his soul [i.e., to forbid to himself something which is permitted (but not, to permit to himself something which is forbidden)],
he shall not profane his word.
According to all that issues from his mouth shall he do.
And a woman, if she vow a vow to the L-rd
and bind a bond (see above) in her father's house [(i.e., when she is under her father's authority)],

in her maidenhood, [after twelve years and one day, (and not when she is a minor, in which instance her vow is not a vow, nor when she is a bogereth (after maidenhood), in which instance she is not under her father's authority for him to annul her vow)],

pairs.hebrew: וְשָׁמַ֨ע אָבִ֜יהָ אֶת־נִדְרָ֗הּ וֶֽאֱסָרָהּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽסְרָ֣ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֔הּ
pairs.english: And her father hear her vow and her bond wherewith she bound her soul,
and her father be silent to her,
then all of her vows shall stand,
and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
And if her father constrain her [i.e., if he annuls her vow] on the day that he hears,

pairs.hebrew: כׇּל־נְדָרֶ֗יהָ וֶֽאֱסָרֶ֛יהָ אֲשֶׁר־אָסְרָ֥ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יָק֑וּם
pairs.english: then all her vows and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall not stand,

and the L-rd shall forgive her, for her father has constrained her. [(Scripture speaks of a woman whose husband, unknown to her, had annulled a vow of Naziritism that he had heard her make, and who had violated her vow by drinking wine or by becoming unclean to the dead. Though the vow is annulled, she requires forgiveness. (How much more so, one whose vow was not annulled!)]
And if she be [betrothed] to a man,

and her vows [that she vowed in her father's house] be upon her, [her father not having heard them, so that they were neither annulled nor confirmed, (annulment being effected only jointly, by her father and her betrothed)],

pairs.hebrew: א֚וֹ מִבְטָ֣א שְׂפָתֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְרָ֖ה עַל־נַפְשָֽׁהּ׃
pairs.english: or the utterance of her lips wherewith she bound her soul,

pairs.hebrew: וְשָׁמַ֥ע אִישָׁ֛הּ בְּי֥וֹם שׇׁמְע֖וֹ וְהֶחֱרִ֣ישׁ לָ֑הּ
pairs.english: And her husband [i.e., her betrothed] hear, on the day that he hear, and he be silent to her,
then her vows shall stand,
and her bonds with which she bound her soul shall stand.

pairs.hebrew: וְ֠אִ֠ם בְּי֨וֹם שְׁמֹ֣עַ אִישָׁהּ֮ יָנִ֣יא אוֹתָהּ֒
pairs.english: And if on the day that her husband hear, he constrain her

pairs.hebrew: וְהֵפֵ֗ר אֶת־נִדְרָהּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ וְאֵת֙ מִבְטָ֣א שְׂפָתֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְרָ֖ה עַל־נַפְשָׁ֑הּ
pairs.english: and annul [(jointly, with her father)] her vow which is upon her and the utterance of her lips wherewith she bound her soul,
then the L-rd shall forgive her.
And the vow of a widow [from marriage (as opposed to a widow from betrothal, in which instance she returns to her father's authority)] or of a divorced woman —
everything wherewith she binds her soul shall stand with her.
And if in the house of her husband [in marriage (as opposed to betrothal)] she vowed,
or bound her soul with a bond by swearing,

pairs.hebrew: וְשָׁמַ֤ע אִישָׁהּ֙ וְהֶחֱרִ֣שׁ לָ֔הּ לֹ֥א הֵנִ֖יא אֹתָ֑הּ
pairs.english: And her husband heard and was silent to her and did not constrain her,
then all of her vows shall stand,
and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
And if her husband annul them on the day of his hearing,

pairs.hebrew: כׇּל־מוֹצָ֨א שְׂפָתֶ֧יהָ לִנְדָרֶ֛יהָ וּלְאִסַּ֥ר נַפְשָׁ֖הּ לֹ֣א יָק֑וּם
pairs.english: then every utterance of her lips for her vows and for binding her soul shall not stand;
her husband has annulled them and the L-rd will forgive her.
Every vow and every oath of binding to afflict the soul,
her husband shall confirm it
and her husband shall annul it.

pairs.hebrew: וְאִם־הַחֲרֵשׁ֩ יַחֲרִ֨ישׁ לָ֥הּ אִישָׁהּ֮ מִיּ֣וֹם אֶל־יוֹם֒
pairs.english: And if her husband be silent to her from day to day [i.e., until it gets dark],

pairs.hebrew: וְהֵקִים֙ אֶת־כׇּל־נְדָרֶ֔יהָ א֥וֹ אֶת־כׇּל־אֱסָרֶ֖יהָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֑יהָ
pairs.english: then he has confirmed all of her vows or all of her bonds which are upon her.

pairs.hebrew: הֵקִ֣ים אֹתָ֔ם כִּי־הֶחֱרִ֥שׁ לָ֖הּ בְּי֥וֹם שׇׁמְעֽוֹ׃
pairs.english: He has confirmed them for he was silent to her on the day of his hearing.
And if he annul them after having heard [and confirmed them (even on the same day)],
then he shall bear her sin [i.e., he takes her place (for punishment)].

pairs.hebrew: אֵ֣לֶּה הַֽחֻקִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֔ה
pairs.english: These are the statutes which the L-rd commanded Moses,
between a man and his wife,
between a father and his daughter, in her maidenhood (in) the house of her father.
And the L-rd spoke to Moses,
saying:

pairs.hebrew: נְקֹ֗ם נִקְמַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאֵ֖ת הַמִּדְיָנִ֑ים
pairs.english: Take the revenge of the children of Israel from the Midianites [(but not from the Moavites, the latter having been motivated by fear of Israel's plundering them, but the former having entered into a quarrel which was not theirs)];
afterwards you will be gathered unto your people.
And Moses spoke to the people [(with joy, though his death was attendant upon the defeat of Midian)], saying:
Arm from yourselves men [tzaddikim] for the host,
and let them be against Midian to execute the vengeance of the L-rd against Midian [(opposing Israel being tantamount to opposing the L-rd)].
A thousand to a tribe, a thousand to a tribe,
of all the tribes of Israel [including the tribe of Levi] shall you send to the host.
And there were handed over [(perforce)] of the thousands of Israel, [(the men, knowing that Moses' death was attendant upon the defeat of Midian, refusing to come forward on their own)],
a thousand to a tribe,
twelve thousand men armed for the host.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶ֥לֶף לַמַּטֶּ֖ה לַצָּבָ֑א
pairs.english: And Moses sent them, a thousand to a tribe, to the host,

them and Pinchas the son of Elazar the Cohein to the host, [Pinchas being "equivalent" to all of them, (and Pinchas going rather than Elazar in that he began the mitzvah (of executing vengeance against Midian) by having slain Kazbi, the daughter of Tzur)],
and the holy articles [the ark and the tzitz] and the trumpets of teruah in his hand [i.e., with him].

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיִּצְבְּאוּ֙ עַל־מִדְיָ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֑ה
pairs.english: And they warred against Midian as the L-rd had commanded Moses,
and they killed every male.
And the kings of Midian they killed, [causing them to fall] upon their slain:

pairs.hebrew: אֶת־אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־רֶ֙קֶם֙ וְאֶת־צ֤וּר וְאֶת־חוּר֙ וְאֶת־רֶ֔בַע חֲמֵ֖שֶׁת מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֑ן
pairs.english: Evi and Rekem, and Tzur, and Chur, and Reva, the five kings of Midian ["of one counsel (against Israel) and of one death"];
and Bilam the son of Beor they slew by the sword [("He exchanged his trade for theirs (desiring to destroy Israel by speech), and they exchanged their trade for his" (killing him by the sword)].
And the children of Israel took captive the women of Midian; and their little ones
and all of their beasts and all of their cattle and all of their goods they took as spoil.
And all of their cities where they dwelt, and all of their cloisters [the dwellings of their priests]
they burned with fire.
And they took all of the spoil, and all of the booty,
of man and of beast.

pairs.hebrew: וַיָּבִ֡אוּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֩ וְאֶל־אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְאֶל־עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל
pairs.english: And they [took nothing for themselves, but] brought to Moses, and to Elazar the Cohein, and to the congregation of the children of Israel:
the captivity [the people], and the booty [the animals], and the spoils [clothing and ornaments],
to the camp in the plains of Moav by the Jordan (near) Jericho.

pairs.hebrew: וַיֵּ֨צְא֜וּ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן וְכׇל־נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לִקְרָאתָ֑ם
pairs.english: And Moses and Elazar the Cohein and all the chiefs of the congregation went out to them
outside the encampment, [seeing the youth of Israel going out to snatch the spoils].
And Moses was wroth with the commanders of the host [("The leaders, failing to protest, are accountable for the sins of the generation")],
the officers of the thousands, and the officers of the hundreds,
who came from the host of battle.
And Moses said to them:
Have you let all the females live!

pairs.hebrew: הֵ֣ן הֵ֜נָּה הָי֨וּ לִבְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בִּדְבַ֣ר בִּלְעָ֔ם
pairs.english: These are the women [(They recognized the particular women with whom particular men had sinned)] who were [consigned to harlotry] to the children of Israel by the counsel of Bilam
to commit perfidy against the L-rd in the affair of Peor,
bringing the plague upon the congregation of the L-rd.
And now, kill every male among the little ones;

pairs.hebrew: וְכׇל־אִשָּׁ֗ה יֹדַ֥עַת אִ֛ישׁ לְמִשְׁכַּ֥ב זָכָ֖ר הֲרֹֽגוּ׃
pairs.english: and every woman [capable of] knowing a man for carnal relations, kill.

pairs.hebrew: וְכֹל֙ הַטַּ֣ף בַּנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר
pairs.english: And all the little ones among the women who did not know carnal relations,
keep alive for yourselves.

pairs.hebrew: וְאַתֶּ֗ם חֲנ֛וּ מִח֥וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים
pairs.english: And you, abide outside the camp [the azarah] seven days.

pairs.hebrew: כֹּל֩ הֹרֵ֨ג נֶ֜פֶשׁ וְכֹ֣ל ׀ נֹגֵ֣עַ בֶּֽחָלָ֗ל
pairs.english: Whoever has killed a man [by striking him with a weapon susceptible of uncleanliness] and whoever has touched a slain one

pairs.hebrew: תִּֽתְחַטְּא֞וּ בַּיּ֤וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י אַתֶּ֖ם וּשְׁבִיכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: shall you cleanse [with the sprinkling waters (of the red heifer)] on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives [who become unclean after they are proselytized].
And every garment, and every vessel of skin, and every work of goats [including vessels made from horns or hooves or bones], and every vessel of wood
shall you cleanse.

pairs.hebrew: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַצָּבָ֔א הַבָּאִ֖ים לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה
pairs.english: And Elazar the Cohein said to the men of the host who came to the war [(Moses, by giving vent to anger (14), having forgotten the halachah)]:

pairs.hebrew: זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַתּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃
pairs.english: This is the statute of the Torah which the L-rd commanded Moses, [Elazar attributing the ruling to his teacher].
But [you may not use vessels, even after they have been cleansed from dead-body uncleanliness, until they are cleansed from carrion absorption] — the gold and the silver,
the copper, the iron, the tin and the lead —

pairs.hebrew: כׇּל־דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־יָבֹ֣א בָאֵ֗שׁ תַּעֲבִ֤ירוּ בָאֵשׁ֙ וְטָהֵ֔ר
pairs.english: Every thing that comes into the fire [to cook something in it] shall you pass through the fire [to cleanse it from carrion absorption, (vessels being cleansed according to the manner of their use)], and it shall be clean [of carrion uncleanliness];
but with the sprinkling waters shall it be cleansed [of dead-body uncleanliness].

pairs.hebrew: וְכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־יָבֹ֛א בָּאֵ֖שׁ תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ בַמָּֽיִם׃
pairs.english: And every thing that does not come into the fire, [such as cups and flasks, which are used for cold things and do not absorb forbidden matter] shall you pass through water [i.e., it is sufficient to immerse them].
And you shall wash your garments on the seventh day and you shall be clean,
and then you shall come to the camp [the camp of the Shechinah (one with dead-body uncleanliness not needing to be sent out of the Levite and Israeli camps)].
And the L-rd said
to Moses:

pairs.hebrew: שָׂ֗א אֵ֣ת רֹ֤אשׁ מַלְק֙וֹחַ֙ הַשְּׁבִ֔י בָּאָדָ֖ם וּבַבְּהֵמָ֑ה
pairs.english: Count the taking of the captivity in man and beast,

pairs.hebrew: אַתָּה֙ וְאֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְרָאשֵׁ֖י אֲב֥וֹת הָעֵדָֽה׃
pairs.english: you and Elazar the Cohein and the heads of the fathers of the congregation.

pairs.hebrew: וְחָצִ֙יתָ֙ אֶת־הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ בֵּ֚ין תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים לַצָּבָ֑א
pairs.english: And divide the booty between the warriors who went out to the host
and the entire congregation [(half to the first, half to the second)].

pairs.hebrew: וַהֲרֵמֹתָ֨ מֶ֜כֶס לַֽיהֹוָ֗ה מֵאֵ֞ת אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים לַצָּבָ֔א
pairs.english: And raise a tribute to the L-rd from the men of the war who went out to the host,
one soul from the five hundred:
from the people, from the herd, from the asses, and from the flock.
From their half shall you take it,
and you shall give it to Elazar the Cohein, the terumah (offering) of the L-rd.

pairs.hebrew: וּמִמַּחֲצִ֨ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּקַּ֣ח ׀ אֶחָ֣ד ׀ אָחֻ֣ז מִן־הַחֲמִשִּׁ֗ים
pairs.english: And from the half of the children of Israel shall you take one portion out of fifty:
from the people, from the herd, from the asses, from the flock, from all of the beasts;

pairs.hebrew: וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתָם֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֕י מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהֹוָֽה׃
pairs.english: and you shall give them to the Levites, keepers of the charge of the mishkan of the L-rd.
And Moses and Elazar the Cohein did
as the L-rd had commanded Moses.

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיְהִי֙ הַמַּלְק֔וֹחַ יֶ֣תֶר הַבָּ֔ז אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּזְז֖וּ עַ֣ם הַצָּבָ֑א
pairs.english: And the booty [of men and animals] was — aside from the spoils [of metaltelin (movable objects)], which the men of the host had taken for themselves —

pairs.hebrew: צֹ֗אן שֵׁשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים׃
pairs.english: sheep, six hundred and seventy-five thousand.
And cattle,
seventy-two thousand.
And asses,
sixty-one thousand.

pairs.hebrew: וְנֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם מִ֨ן־הַנָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר
pairs.english: And souls, of the women who had not had carnal relations,
all of the souls, thirty-two thousand.
And the (first) half was, the share of those who went out to the host:

pairs.hebrew: מִסְפַּ֣ר הַצֹּ֗אן שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְשִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
pairs.english: the number of sheep, three hundred and thirty-seven thousand and five hundred.
And the tribute to the L-rd from the flock was
six hundred and seventy-five.
And the cattle, thirty-six thousand;
and their tribute to the L-rd, seventy-two.
And the asses, thirty thousand and five hundred;
and their tribute to the L-rd, sixty-one.
And souls, sixteen thousand;
and their tribute to the L-rd, thirty-two souls.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶת־מֶ֙כֶס֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה לְאֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַכֹּהֵ֑ן
pairs.english: And Moses gave the tribute, the terumah of the L-rd, to Elazar the Cohein,
as the L-rd had commanded Moses.
And of the half of the children of Israel,
which Moses had divided [for the congregation] from the men of the host —
The half of the congregation from the flock was

pairs.hebrew: שְׁלֹשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
pairs.english: three hundred and thirty-seven thousand and five hundred.
And cattle,
thirty-six thousand.
And asses,
thirty thousand and five hundred.
And souls,
sixteen thousand.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִמַּחֲצִ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת־הָֽאָחֻז֙ אֶחָ֣ד מִן־הַחֲמִשִּׁ֔ים מִן־הָאָדָ֖ם וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה
pairs.english: — And Moses took from the half of the children of Israel, one portion out of fifty, from the people and from the beasts,

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתָ֜ם לַלְוִיִּ֗ם שֹֽׁמְרֵי֙ מִשְׁמֶ֙רֶת֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהֹוָ֔ה
pairs.english: and he gave them to the Levites, keepers of the charge of the mishkan of the L-rd,
as the L-rd had commanded Moses.

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיִּקְרְבוּ֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַפְּקֻדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַלְפֵ֣י הַצָּבָ֑א
pairs.english: And there drew near to Moses those appointed over the thousands of the host,
the officers of the thousands and the officers of the hundreds.
And they said to Moses:

pairs.hebrew: עֲבָדֶ֣יךָ נָֽשְׂא֗וּ אֶת־רֹ֛אשׁ אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיָדֵ֑נוּ
pairs.english: Your servants have counted the men of war who were under our charge,
and not one of us is missing.
And we have presented the offering of the L-rd,

pairs.hebrew: אִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א כְלִֽי־זָהָב֙ אֶצְעָדָ֣ה וְצָמִ֔יד טַבַּ֖עַת עָגִ֣יל וְכוּמָ֑ז
pairs.english: each what he has found: golden vessels, foot bands, arm bands, rings, ear rings, and kumaz [pudendal ornaments (to atone for lustful thoughts towards the daughters of Midian)]
to atone for our souls before the L-rd.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־הַזָּהָ֖ב מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם
pairs.english: And Moses and Elazar the Cohein took the gold from them,
all wrought articles.

pairs.hebrew: וַיְהִ֣י ׀ כׇּל־זְהַ֣ב הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵרִ֙ימוּ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה
pairs.english: And all the gold of the terumah that they devoted to the L-rd was

pairs.hebrew: שִׁשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף שְׁבַע־מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁ֑קֶל
pairs.english: sixteen thousand and seven hundred and fifty shekels,

pairs.hebrew: מֵאֵת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָֽאֲלָפִ֔ים וּמֵאֵ֖ת שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֵּאֽוֹת׃
pairs.english: from the officers of the thousands and from the officer of the hundreds.
Each of the men of the host
had taken spoils for himself.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְאֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַכֹּהֵן֙ אֶת־הַזָּהָ֔ב מֵאֵ֛ת שָׂרֵ֥י הָאֲלָפִ֖ים וְהַמֵּא֑וֹת
pairs.english: And Moses and Elazar the Cohein took the gold from the officers of the thousands and the hundreds,
and they brought it to the tent of meeting,
a memorial for the children of Israel before the L-rd.

pairs.hebrew: וּמִקְנֶ֣ה ׀ רַ֗ב הָיָ֞ה לִבְנֵ֧י רְאוּבֵ֛ן וְלִבְנֵי־גָ֖ד עָצ֣וּם מְאֹ֑ד
pairs.english: And the sons of Reuven and the sons of Gad had much cattle, a great multitude,
and they saw the land of Yazer and the land of Gilead,
and behold, it was a place of cattle.
And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuven came,

pairs.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֙ וְאֶל־אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶל־נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
pairs.english: and they said to Moses and Elazar the Cohein and to the chiefs of the congregation:

pairs.hebrew: עֲטָר֤וֹת וְדִיבֹן֙ וְיַעְזֵ֣ר וְנִמְרָ֔ה וְחֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְאֶלְעָלֵ֑ה
pairs.english: Ataroth and Divon and Yazer and Nimrah and Cheshbon and Elaleh
and Sevam and Nevo and Beon [(of the land of Sichon and Og)] —

pairs.hebrew: הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ לִפְנֵי֙ עֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
pairs.english: The land which the L-rd smote before the congregation of Israel —
it is a land of cattle,
and your servants have cattle.
And they said: If we have found favor in your eyes,
let this land be given to your servants as a holding;
do not have us cross the Jordan.
And Moses said to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuven:
Would your brothers go to the war
and you remain here!
And why would you dishearten the children of Israel
from crossing into the land which the L-rd has given to them, [giving them the impression that you are in awe of the strength of the Canaanites and fear warring with them]?
Thus did your fathers do

pairs.hebrew: בְּשׇׁלְחִ֥י אֹתָ֛ם מִקָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לִרְא֥וֹת אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
pairs.english: when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
And they went up until Nachal Eshkol and they saw the land,
and they disheartened the children of Israel,
that they not come to the land that the L-rd gave to them.
And the L-rd was wroth on that day,
and He swore, saying:

pairs.hebrew: אִם־יִרְא֨וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֜ים הָעֹלִ֣ים מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה
pairs.english: If the men who went up out of Egypt from twenty years and above shall see (i.e., I swear that they shall not see)

pairs.hebrew: אֵ֚ת הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֑ב
pairs.english: the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob,
for they have not fulfilled (My behest by following) after Me.

pairs.hebrew: בִּלְתִּ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּה֙ הַקְּנִזִּ֔י וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נ֑וּן
pairs.english: Except Calev the son of Yefuneh, the Kenizi [(Calev was the stepson of Kenaz, to whom Calev's mother bore Othniel (see Joshua 15:17)] and Joshua the son of Nun,
for they have fulfilled (the L-rd's behest by following) after the L-rd.
And the L-rd was wroth with Israel,
and He made them wander in the desert forty years

pairs.hebrew: עַד־תֹּם֙ כׇּל־הַדּ֔וֹר הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
pairs.english: until the entire generation that did the evil in the eyes of the L-rd had been consumed.

pairs.hebrew: וְהִנֵּ֣ה קַמְתֶּ֗ם תַּ֚חַת אֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם תַּרְבּ֖וּת אֲנָשִׁ֣ים חַטָּאִ֑ים
pairs.english: And, behold, you have arisen in your fathers' place, a growth of sinful men,

pairs.hebrew: לִסְפּ֣וֹת ע֗וֹד עַ֛ל חֲר֥וֹן אַף־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
pairs.english: to add even more to the wrath of the L-rd against Israel!
If you turn back from Him,
He will place them in the desert yet again,
and you will have destroyed all this people!
And they drew near to him and they said:
We will build sheepfolds for our kine here
and cities for our little ones [(placing their wealth before their children!)]

pairs.hebrew: וַאֲנַ֜חְנוּ נֵחָלֵ֣ץ חֻשִׁ֗ים לִפְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
pairs.english: And we will arm ourselves speedily (to go) at the head [of the columns] of the children of Israel [(the men of Gad and Reuven being warriors (see Deuteronomy 33:20, 3:18, and Joshua 6:13)]
until we have brought them to their place,

pairs.hebrew: וְיָשַׁ֤ב טַפֵּ֙נוּ֙ בְּעָרֵ֣י הַמִּבְצָ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
pairs.english: and our little ones will abide in the fortified cities against the inhabitants of the land.
We shall not return to our houses

pairs.hebrew: עַ֗ד הִתְנַחֵל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃
pairs.english: until the children of Israel have inherited, each his inheritance.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נִנְחַל֙ אִתָּ֔ם מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וָהָ֑לְאָה
pairs.english: For we will not inherit with them across the Jordan and beyond [on the western side],

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י בָ֤אָה נַחֲלָתֵ֙נוּ֙ אֵלֵ֔ינוּ מֵעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָה׃ {פ}
pairs.english: for our inheritance has come to us [i.e., we have already accepted it] across the Jordan eastwards.
And Moses said to them:
If you do this thing —
If you arm yourselves before the L-rd for the war,

pairs.hebrew: וְעָבַ֨ר לָכֶ֧ם כׇּל־חָל֛וּץ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה
pairs.english: And every armed man of you will cross the Jordan before the L-rd
until He drives out His enemies before Him,

pairs.hebrew: וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֨ה הָאָ֜רֶץ לִפְנֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ וְאַחַ֣ר תָּשֻׁ֔בוּ
pairs.english: And the land be conquered before the L-rd, and then you return —
then you will be clean of (guilt against) the L-rd and of (guilt against) Israel,

pairs.hebrew: וְ֠הָיְתָ֠ה הָאָ֨רֶץ הַזֹּ֥את לָכֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
pairs.english: and this land will be a holding unto you before the L-rd.

pairs.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹ֤א תַעֲשׂוּן֙ כֵּ֔ן הִנֵּ֥ה חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַיהֹוָ֑ה
pairs.english: But if you do not do so, you have sinned against the L-rd,
and know your sin that shall find you.
Build for yourselves cities for your little ones and folds for your sheep [(first the cities, then the folds! (see 16)]

and what leaves your mouths [to the L rd (that you would remain in the land until they have apportioned it (18)] shall you do [(even though Moses had asked that they remain only until they had conquered it (22)].

pairs.hebrew: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בְּנֵי־גָד֙ וּבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר
pairs.english: And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuven said to Moses [all as one]:
Your servants will do as my lord commands.
Our little ones, our wives, our kine, and all of our beasts
shall be there in the cities of Gilead.

pairs.hebrew: וַעֲבָדֶ֨יךָ יַֽעַבְר֜וּ כׇּל־חֲל֥וּץ צָבָ֛א לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה
pairs.english: And your servants shall pass over, every armed man of the host before the L rd to the war,
as my lord speaks.
And Moses appointed over them [(to insure the fulfillment of their conditions)]

pairs.hebrew: אֵ֚ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֑וּן
pairs.english: Elazar the Cohein, Joshua the son of Nun,
and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel.
And Moses said to them:

pairs.hebrew: אִם־יַעַבְר֣וּ בְנֵי־גָ֣ד וּבְנֵי־רְאוּבֵ֣ן ׀ אִ֠תְּכֶ֠ם אֶֽת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֞ן כׇּל־חָל֤וּץ לַמִּלְחָמָה֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: If the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuven cross the Jordan with you, each man armed for the war before the L rd, and the land be conquered before you,
then you shall give to them the land of the Gilead as a holding.
And if they do not cross over armed before you,
then they shall have a holding in your midst in the land of Canaan.
And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuven answered, saying:

pairs.hebrew: אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה׃
pairs.english: What the L rd spoke to your servants, thus shall we do.

pairs.hebrew: נַ֣חְנוּ נַעֲבֹ֧ר חֲלוּצִ֛ים לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן
pairs.english: We shall pass over armed before the L rd into the land of Canaan,
and with us [i.e., in our possession and under our jurisdiction] the holding of our inheritance across the Jordan.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֣ם ׀ מֹשֶׁ֡ה לִבְנֵי־גָד֩ וְלִבְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן וְלַחֲצִ֣י ׀ שֵׁ֣בֶט ׀ מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן־יוֹסֵ֗ף
pairs.english: And Moses gave to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuven and to half the tribe of Menasheh the son of Joseph

pairs.hebrew: אֶת־מַמְלֶ֙כֶת֙ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֶ֨ת־מַמְלֶ֔כֶת ע֖וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן
pairs.english: the kingdom of Sichon the king of the Emori and the kingdom of Og the king of the Bashan,

pairs.hebrew: הָאָ֗רֶץ לְעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ בִּגְבֻלֹ֔ת עָרֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ סָבִֽיב׃
pairs.english: the land with the cities in its boundaries, the cities of the land roundabout.
And the children of Gad built Divon and Ataroth
and Aroer.
And Atroth-Shofan
and Yazer and Yagbehah.
And Beth Nimrah and Beth Haran [(all of these cities to be)]
fortified cities and folds for sheep (see 24).
And the sons of Reuven built Cheshbon and Elalei
and Kiryathaim.

pairs.hebrew: וְאֶת־נְב֞וֹ וְאֶת־בַּ֧עַל מְע֛וֹן מֽוּסַבֹּ֥ת שֵׁ֖ם וְאֶת־שִׂבְמָ֑ה
pairs.english: And Nevo and Ba'al Meon [named after Emorite deities], their names being altered, and Sivmah [(the same as Sevam (3)];

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּקְרְא֣וּ בְשֵׁמֹ֔ת אֶת־שְׁמ֥וֹת הֶעָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנֽוּ׃
pairs.english: and they called by (new) names the names of the cities that they built.

pairs.hebrew: וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ בְּנֵ֨י מָכִ֧יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה גִּלְעָ֖דָה וַֽיִּלְכְּדֻ֑הָ
pairs.english: And the sons of Machir the son of Menasheh went to Gilead and they took it,
and they drove out the Emori that were in it.
And Moses gave the Gilead to Machir the son of Menasheh
and he dwelt in it.
And Yair the son of Menasheh went and he took their villages (chavotheihem)
and he called them Chavoth Yair [(as a memorial, having no sons)].
And Novach went and he took Kenath and its villages,
and he called it Novach by his name.

pairs.hebrew: אֵ֜לֶּה מַסְעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצְא֛וּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם
pairs.english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, who went out of the land of Egypt by their hosts,

by the hand of Moses and Aaron. [These are recorded to apprise us of the L-rd's lovingkindness, viz.: Though He decreed that they wander in the desert, they actually made only twenty journeys in thirty-eight years.]

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־מוֹצָאֵיהֶ֛ם לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־פִּ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה
pairs.english: And Moses wrote down their goings forth according to their journeys by word of the L-rd;
and these are their journeys by their goings forth.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּסְע֤וּ מֵֽרַעְמְסֵס֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן
pairs.english: And they journeyed from Ra'amses on the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month.

pairs.hebrew: מִֽמׇּחֳרַ֣ת הַפֶּ֗סַח יָצְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּיָ֣ד רָמָ֔ה
pairs.english: On the morrow of the Pesach the children of Israel went out with a high hand
in the sight of all of Egypt.

pairs.hebrew: וּמִצְרַ֣יִם מְקַבְּרִ֗ים אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה בָּהֶ֖ם כׇּל־בְּכ֑וֹר
pairs.english: And Egypt was burying [(engrossed in mourning)] those whom the L-rd had smitten of them — every first-born.
And in their gods the L-rd wrought judgment.
And the children of Israel journeyed from Ra'amses
and they encamped in Succoth.
And they journeyed from Succoth
and they encamped in Eitham at the edge of the desert.
And they journeyed from Eitham

pairs.hebrew: וַיָּ֙שׇׁב֙ עַל־פִּ֣י הַחִירֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־פְּנֵ֖י בַּ֣עַל צְפ֑וֹן
pairs.english: and they abode at Pi-Hachiroth, which fronts Ba'al Tzefon;
and they encamped before Migdol.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הַֽחִירֹ֔ת וַיַּֽעַבְר֥וּ בְתוֹךְ־הַיָּ֖ם הַמִּדְבָּ֑רָה
pairs.english: And they journeyed from Pi-Hachiroth and passed in the midst of the sea to the desert,

pairs.hebrew: וַיֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר אֵתָ֔ם
pairs.english: and they went a distance of three days in the desert of Eitham
and they encamped in Marah.
And they journeyed from Marah and they came to Eilim.

pairs.hebrew: וּ֠בְאֵילִ֠ם שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֞ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֛יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים תְּמָרִ֖ים
pairs.english: And in Eilim there were twelve springs and seventy palm trees,
and they encamped there.
And they journeyed from Eilim
and they encamped by the Red Sea.
And they journeyed from the Red Sea
and they encamped in the desert of Sin.
And they journeyed from the desert of Sin
and they encamped in Dafkah.
And they journeyed from Dafkah
and they encamped in Alush.
And they journeyed from Alush and they encamped in Refidim.
And there was no water there for the people to drink.
And they journeyed from Refidim
and they encamped in the desert of Sinai.
And they journeyed from the desert of Sinai
and they encamped in Kivroth Hata'avah.
And they journeyed from Kivroth Hata'avah
and they encamped in Chatzeroth.
And they journeyed from Chatzeroth
and they encamped in Rithmah [so called because of the spies' slander, which is likened (Psalms 20:34) to juniper coals (gachalei rethamim)].
And they journeyed from Rithmah
and they encamped in Rimon Paretz.
And they journeyed from Rimon Paretz
and they encamped in Livnah.
And they journeyed from Livnah
and they encamped in Rissah.
And they journeyed from Rissah
and they encamped in Kehelathah.
And they journeyed from Kehelathah
and they encamped in Har Shafer.
And they journeyed from Har Shafer
and they encamped in Charadah.
And they journeyed from Charadah
and they encamped in Makheloth.
And they journeyed from Makheloth
and they encamped in Tachath.
And they journeyed from Tachath
and they encamped in Tarach.
And they journeyed from Tarach
and they encamped in Mithkah.
And they journeyed from Mithkah
and they encamped in Chashmonah.
And they journeyed from Chashmonah
and they encamped in Moseroth.
And they journeyed from Moseroth
and they encamped in Bnei Ya'akan.
And they journeyed from Bnei Ya'akan
and they encamped in Chor Hagidgad.
And they journeyed from Chor Hagidgad
and they encamped in Yatvathah.
And they journeyed from Yatvathah
and they encamped in Avronah.
And they journeyed from Avronah
and they encamped in Etzyon Gaver.
And they journeyed from Etzyon Gaver
and they encamped in the desert of Sin, which is Kadesh.
And they journeyed from Kadesh

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּהֹ֣ר הָהָ֔ר בִּקְצֵ֖ה אֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם׃
pairs.english: and they encamped in Hor Hahar, at the edge of the land of Edom.

pairs.hebrew: וַיַּ֩עַל֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַכֹּהֵ֜ן אֶל־הֹ֥ר הָהָ֛ר עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה וַיָּ֣מׇת שָׁ֑ם
pairs.english: And Aaron the Cohein went up to Hor Hahar by the "mouth" of the L-rd, and he died there [by the Divine kiss]

pairs.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֗ים לְצֵ֤את בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם
pairs.english: in the fortieth year of the exodus of the children of Israel from the land of Egypt,
in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
And Aaron was one hundred and twenty-three years old
when he died in Hor Hahar.
And the Canaanite heard, the king of Arad [that Aaron had died and the clouds of glory had departed (and he felt that Israel was now vulnerable to attack)].
And he was dwelling in the south, in the land of Canaan,
when the children of Israel came.
And they journeyed from Hor Hahar
and they encamped in Tzalmonah.
And they journeyed from Tzalmonah
and they encamped in Punon.
And they journeyed from Punon
and they encamped in Ovoth.
And they journeyed from Ovoth
and they encamped in Iyei ["the wastes"] of Avarim on the boundary of Moav.
And they journeyed from Iyim
and they encamped in Divon Gad.
And they journeyed from Divon Gad
and they encamped in Almon Divlathaymah.
And they journeyed from Almon Divlathaymah
and they encamped in Harei Ha'avarim before Nevo.
And they journeyed from Harei Ha'avarim

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּעַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ׃
pairs.english: and they encamped in the plains of Moav by the Jordan (near) Jericho.

pairs.hebrew: וַיַּחֲנ֤וּ עַל־הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִבֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁמֹ֔ת עַ֖ד אָבֵ֣ל הַשִּׁטִּ֑ים
pairs.english: And they encamped by the Jordan from Beth Hayeshimoth until Aveil [the plain of] Shittim
in the plains of Moav [a distance of twelve miles].
And the L-rd spoke to Moses
in the plains of Moav by the Jordan (near) Jericho, saying:
Speak to the children of Israel and say to them:

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן׃
pairs.english: When you are crossing the Jordan [on the dry land] to the land of Canaan, [cross with the following intent (52), that you will drive out the inhabitants of the land, (lacking which, the waters will return and drown you (See Joshua 4:10)].
And you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land before you,
and you shall destroy all their temples [where they prostrated themselves to idolatry];

pairs.hebrew: וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־צַלְמֵ֤י מַסֵּֽכֹתָם֙ תְּאַבֵּ֔דוּ וְאֵ֥ת כׇּל־בָּמוֹתָ֖ם תַּשְׁמִֽידוּ׃
pairs.english: and all their molten images shall you destroy, and all of their sacrificial mounds shall you raze.
And [when] you rid the land [of its inhabitants], you will [be able to] dwell therein;

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֥י לָכֶ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אֹתָֽהּ׃
pairs.english: for to you have I given the land to inherit it.
And you shall possess the land by lot according to your families.

pairs.hebrew: לָרַ֞ב תַּרְבּ֤וּ אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ וְלַמְעַט֙ תַּמְעִ֣יט אֶת־נַחֲלָת֔וֹ
pairs.english: For the many shall you increase his inheritance, and for the few shall you decrease his inheritance.

pairs.hebrew: אֶל֩ אֲשֶׁר־יֵ֨צֵא ל֥וֹ שָׁ֛מָּה הַגּוֹרָ֖ל ל֣וֹ יִהְיֶ֑ה
pairs.english: Wherever the lot falls for him, it (i.e., that land) shall be his.
By the tribes of your fathers [according to the number that left Egypt] shall you inherit.
And if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land before you,

pairs.hebrew: וְהָיָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תּוֹתִ֣ירוּ מֵהֶ֔ם לְשִׂכִּים֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיכֶ֔ם וְלִצְנִינִ֖ם בְּצִדֵּיכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: then those you leave over of them shall be as pegs in your eyes and as thorn hedges on your sides ["hedging" you in],

pairs.hebrew: וְצָרְר֣וּ אֶתְכֶ֔ם עַל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
pairs.english: and they will vex you on the land in which you dwell.
And it shall be, as I thought to do to them,
I shall do to you.
And the L-rd spoke to Moses,
saying:
Command the children of Israel and say to them:
When you come to the land, Canaan,

pairs.hebrew: זֹ֣את הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפֹּ֤ל לָכֶם֙ בְּֽנַחֲלָ֔ה אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן לִגְבֻלֹתֶֽיהָ׃
pairs.english: this is the land that shall fall to you [by lot] for an inheritance, the land of Canaan, by its borders: [(Because many mitzvoth obtain in Eretz Yisrael and not outside it, it was necessary to delimit the boundaries exactly.)]

pairs.hebrew: וְהָיָ֨ה לָכֶ֧ם פְּאַת־נֶ֛גֶב מִמִּדְבַּר־צִ֖ן עַל־יְדֵ֣י אֱד֑וֹם
pairs.english: The south side shall be to you from the desert of Tzin near Edom.

pairs.hebrew: וְהָיָ֤ה לָכֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִקְצֵ֥ה יָם־הַמֶּ֖לַח קֵֽדְמָה׃
pairs.english: And your southern border shall be for you from the eastern edge of the Salt Sea.

pairs.hebrew: וְנָסַ֣ב לָכֶם֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה
pairs.english: And the border shall incline for you, [bearing northwest] to the south of Ma'aleh Akrabim [(so that Ma'aleh Akrabim is within the boundary)], and it shall pass on to Tzin.
And its edge shall be south of Kadesh Barnea.
And it shall go out [continuing northwest] to Chatzar Addar, and it shall pass on to Atzmon.
And the border shall incline from Atzmon to Nachal Mitzrayim [the southwest corner of the boundary],
and its [western] edge shall be at the sea.

pairs.hebrew: וּגְב֣וּל יָ֔ם וְהָיָ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל וּגְב֑וּל
pairs.english: And [what is] the western border? The Great Sea and the bounds [i.e., the islands within it)] shall be for you.
This shall be the western border for you.
And this shall be the northern border for you.

pairs.hebrew: מִן־הַיָּם֙ הַגָּדֹ֔ל תְּתָא֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם הֹ֥ר הָהָֽר׃
pairs.english: From the Great Sea you shall turn for yourselves [from west to north] to Hor Hahar [at the northwest corner, sloping into the sea].
From Hor Hahar you shall turn [and bear east (on the northern border)] to the entrance of Chamath [Antioch];
and the edge of the border [on that particular line, before turning backwards to proceed thence in a wider diagonal] shall be to Tzedad.

pairs.hebrew: וְיָצָ֤א הַגְּבֻל֙ זִפְרֹ֔נָה וְהָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖יו חֲצַ֣ר עֵינָ֑ן
pairs.english: And the (northern) border shall go out to Ziphron and its edge [the end of the northern boundary] shall be at Chatzar Einan.
This shall be the northern border for you.
And you shall turn for yourselves to the eastern border,
from Chatzar Einan to Shefam.

pairs.hebrew: וְיָרַ֨ד הַגְּבֻ֧ל מִשְּׁפָ֛ם הָרִבְלָ֖ה מִקֶּ֣דֶם לָעָ֑יִן
pairs.english: And the border shall descend from Shefam to Rivlah, east of Ayin [(so that Ayin is within the boundary)].

pairs.hebrew: וְיָרַ֣ד הַגְּבֻ֔ל וּמָחָ֛ה עַל־כֶּ֥תֶף יָם־כִּנֶּ֖רֶת קֵֽדְמָה׃
pairs.english: And the border shall go down and hit the shoulder of the Sea of Kinnereth on the east [(so that the Sea of Kinnereth, to the west, is within the boundary)].
And the border shall descend to the Jordan [(which flows southeastwards towards Canaan, junctures at the Kinnereth, and spills into the Salt Sea)];
and its [southeast] edge shall be the Salt Sea.

pairs.hebrew: זֹאת֩ תִּהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֥ם הָאָ֛רֶץ לִגְבֻלֹתֶ֖יהָ סָבִֽיב׃
pairs.english: This shall be for you the land, by its borders roundabout.
And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying:

pairs.hebrew: זֹ֣את הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּתְנַחֲל֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ בְּגוֹרָ֔ל
pairs.english: This is the land which you shall take possession of by lot,

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה לָתֵ֛ת לְתִשְׁעַ֥ת הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֥י הַמַּטֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: which the L-rd commanded to give to the nine tribes and the half tribe.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י לָקְח֞וּ מַטֵּ֨ה בְנֵ֤י הָראוּבֵנִי֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם וּמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־הַגָּדִ֖י לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם
pairs.english: For the tribe of the sons of the Reuveni by their fathers' house, and the tribe of the sons of the Gadi by their fathers' house,
and half the tribe of Menasheh have taken their inheritance.

pairs.hebrew: שְׁנֵ֥י הַמַּטּ֖וֹת וַחֲצִ֣י הַמַּטֶּ֑ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗ם
pairs.english: The two tribes and the half tribe have taken their inheritance
across the Jordan from Jericho, to the fore [of the world], to the east.
And the L-rd spoke to Moses,
saying:

pairs.hebrew: אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־יִנְחֲל֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ
pairs.english: These are the names of the men who shall possess the land for you, [each chief acting as the representative of his tribe and apportioning the tribe's inheritance by families and individuals, selecting a portion appropriate for each]:
Elazar the Cohein and Joshua the son of Nun.
And one chief, one chief, from a tribe
shall you take to possess [and take a share in] the land [in your place].
And these are the names of the men:
Of the tribe of Yehudah, Calev ben Yefuneh.
And of the tribe of the sons of Shimon,
Shmuel ben Amihud.
And of the tribe of Binyamin,
Elidad ben Kislon.
And of the tribe of the sons of Dan, the chief,
Bukki ben Yagli.
Of the sons of Joseph, of the tribe of the sons of Menasheh, the chief,
Chaniel ben Efod.
And of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, the chief,
Kemuel ben Shiftan.
And of the tribe of the children of Zevulun, the chief,
Elitzafan ben Parnach.
And of the tribe of the sons of Yissachar, the chief,
Paltiel ben Azan.
And of the tribe of the sons of Asher, the chief,
Achihud ben Shlomi.
And of the tribe of the sons of Naftali, the chief,
Pedahel ben Amihud.
These are (those) whom the L-rd commanded
to effect acquisition [of the land according to its divisions (i.e., families, etc.)] by the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
And the L-rd spoke to Moses
in the plains of Moav by the Jordan (near) Jericho, saying:
Command the children of Israel

pairs.hebrew: וְנָתְנ֣וּ לַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִֽנַּחֲלַ֛ת אֲחֻזָּתָ֖ם עָרִ֣ים לָשָׁ֑בֶת
pairs.english: that they give to the Levites from the inheritance of their holding, cities to dwell in;
and an open space for the cities roundabout [(for beauty, not for building or sowing)] shall you give to the Levites.
And the cities shall be for them to dwell in.

pairs.hebrew: וּמִגְרְשֵׁיהֶ֗ם יִהְי֤וּ לִבְהֶמְתָּם֙ וְלִרְכֻשָׁ֔ם וּלְכֹ֖ל חַיָּתָֽם׃
pairs.english: And their open spaces shall be for their beasts, for their possessions, and for all of their needs.
And the open spaces of the cities that you give to the Levites,

pairs.hebrew: מִקִּ֤יר הָעִיר֙ וָח֔וּצָה אֶ֥לֶף אַמָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃
pairs.english: from the wall of the city and outwards, one thousand cubits roundabout ["two thousand cubits" (5) are to be understood as two thousand cubits all around; the inner thousand for the open space, and the outer, for fields and vineyards.]

pairs.hebrew: וּמַדֹּתֶ֞ם מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֗יר אֶת־פְּאַת־קֵ֣דְמָה אַלְפַּ֪יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֟ה וְאֶת־פְּאַת־נֶ֩גֶב֩ אַלְפַּ֨יִם בָּאַמָּ֜ה
pairs.english: And you shall measure from outside the city: on the east side, two thousand cubits, and on the south side, two thousand cubits,

pairs.hebrew: וְאֶת־פְּאַת־יָ֣ם ׀ אַלְפַּ֣יִם בָּֽאַמָּ֗ה וְאֵ֨ת פְּאַ֥ת צָפ֛וֹן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בָּאַמָּ֖ה וְהָעִ֣יר בַּתָּ֑וֶךְ
pairs.english: and on the west side, two thousand cubits, and on the north side, two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst.
This shall be for them the open spaces of the cities.
And the cities which you shall give to the Levites:

pairs.hebrew: אֵ֚ת שֵׁשׁ־עָרֵ֣י הַמִּקְלָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתְּנ֔וּ לָנֻ֥ס שָׁ֖מָּה הָרֹצֵ֑חַ
pairs.english: the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the slayer to flee there;
and, in addition to them, you shall give forty-two cities.

pairs.hebrew: כׇּל־הֶעָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַלְוִיִּ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה עִ֑יר
pairs.english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites: forty-eight cities,
they and their open places.
And the cities that you give from the holding of the children of Israel:

pairs.hebrew: מֵאֵ֤ת הָרַב֙ תַּרְבּ֔וּ וּמֵאֵ֥ת הַמְעַ֖ט תַּמְעִ֑יטוּ
pairs.english: From the many, shall you give more, and from the few shall you give less.

pairs.hebrew: אִ֗ישׁ כְּפִ֤י נַחֲלָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִנְחָ֔לוּ יִתֵּ֥ן מֵעָרָ֖יו לַלְוִיִּֽם׃ {פ}
pairs.english: Each, according to his inheritance that they shall inherit shall give of his cities to the Levites.
And the L-rd spoke to Moses,
saying:
Speak to the children of Israel and say to them:

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃
pairs.english: When you cross the Jordan to the land of Canaan,

pairs.hebrew: וְהִקְרִיתֶ֤ם לָכֶם֙ עָרִ֔ים עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לָכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: You shall designate cities for yourselves. Cities of refuge shall there be for you.
And there shall flee there a slayer who kills a soul unwittingly.
And the cities shall be for you as a refuge from the avenger [of the blood, who is kin to the slain man];

pairs.hebrew: וְלֹ֤א יָמוּת֙ הָרֹצֵ֔חַ עַד־עׇמְד֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י הָעֵדָ֖ה לַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
pairs.english: and the slayer shall not die until he stand before the congregation for judgment.
And the cities which you shall provide —

six cities of refuge shall there be for you. [(Even though Moses in his lifetime designated three cities across the Jordan as cities of refuge (Deuteronomy 4:41), they did not afford refuge until three had been designated by Joshua in the land of Canaan.)]

pairs.hebrew: אֵ֣ת ׀ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶעָרִ֗ים תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵעֵ֣בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן
pairs.english: The three cities shall you provide across the Jordan,

pairs.hebrew: וְאֵת֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים תִּתְּנ֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן
pairs.english: and the three cities shall you provide in the land of Canaan [(Though there were nine tribes in the land of Canaan, and only two and a half across the Jordan, there were three cities of refuge for both, Gilead (across the Jordan) being "profuse" in slayers)];
cities of refuge shall they be.

pairs.hebrew: לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְלַגֵּ֤ר וְלַתּוֹשָׁב֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔ם תִּהְיֶ֛ינָה שֵׁשׁ־הֶעָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה לְמִקְלָ֑ט
pairs.english: For the children of Israel and for the sojourner and for the dweller in their midst shall these six cities be for refuge,
to flee there all who kill a soul unwittingly.
And if with an iron implement [of any size] he kill him [intentionally], and he die,

he is a murderer — die shall die the murderer, [it being known to the L-rd that any amount of iron can kill. (Other implements must first be established as lethal before the slayer is put to death, viz. (17 and 18): "whereby he can die.")].

pairs.hebrew: וְאִ֡ם בְּאֶ֣בֶן יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר־יָמ֨וּת בָּ֥הּ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת
pairs.english: And if with a hand-stone [i.e., the size of a full hand], whereby he can die [see above], he strike him, and he die,
he is a murderer — die shall die the murderer.

pairs.hebrew: א֡וֹ בִּכְלִ֣י עֵֽץ־יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר־יָמ֨וּת בּ֥וֹ הִכָּ֛הוּ וַיָּמֹ֖ת
pairs.english: Or if with a wooden implement, whereby he can die, he strike him, and he die,
he is a murderer — die shall die the murderer. [(This, to indicate that the "rod" of Exodus 21:20 must be of killing potential.)]
The avenger, he shall kill the murderer;
when he comes upon him, [even within the cities of refuge], he shall kill him.
And if in hatred he thrust him,
or hurl aught at him in ambush, and he die,
Or if in hatred he strike him with his hand, and he die,
then die shall die the smiter; he is a murderer.
The avenger shall kill the murderer when he comes upon him.
And if by accident, without hatred, he thrust him,
or he cast upon him some implement, without ambush,

pairs.hebrew: א֣וֹ בְכׇל־אֶ֜בֶן אֲשֶׁר־יָמ֥וּת בָּהּ֙ בְּלֹ֣א רְא֔וֹת וַיַּפֵּ֥ל עָלָ֖יו וַיָּמֹ֑ת
pairs.english: Or with any stone, whereby one can die he strike him, without seeing [him], and he cast it upon him [with a downward (but not with an upward) movement], and he die,

pairs.hebrew: וְהוּא֙ לֹא־אוֹיֵ֣ב ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ רָעָתֽוֹ׃
pairs.english: and he not be his foe and not intend his evil,

pairs.hebrew: וְשָֽׁפְטוּ֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין הַמַּכֶּ֔ה וּבֵ֖ין גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֑ם
pairs.english: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the avenger
according to these judgments,

pairs.hebrew: וְהִצִּ֨ילוּ הָעֵדָ֜ה אֶת־הָרֹצֵ֗חַ מִיַּד֮ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּם֒
pairs.english: And the congregation shall rescue the slayer from the hand of the avenger,

pairs.hebrew: וְהֵשִׁ֤יבוּ אֹתוֹ֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה אֶל־עִ֥יר מִקְלָט֖וֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָ֣ס שָׁ֑מָּה
pairs.english: and the congregation shall return him to the city of his refuge to which he had fled,

pairs.hebrew: וְיָ֣שַׁב בָּ֗הּ עַד־מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־מָשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ בְּשֶׁ֥מֶן הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
pairs.english: and he shall dwell there until the death of the high-priest who had been anointed with the holy oil, [it not being fitting that he, the slayer, whose act leads to the departure of the Shechinah from Israel and the shortening of their lives abide before the high-priest, whose end is the reposing of the Shechinah upon Israel and the lengthening of their lives)].

pairs.hebrew: וְאִם־יָצֹ֥א יֵצֵ֖א הָרֹצֵ֑חַ אֶת־גְּבוּל֙ עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֔וֹ
pairs.english: And if the murderer go beyond the border of the city of his refuge
whither he has fled,

pairs.hebrew: וּמָצָ֤א אֹתוֹ֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַדָּ֔ם מִח֕וּץ לִגְב֖וּל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑וֹ
pairs.english: And the avenger find him outside the border of the city of his refuge,
then the avenger may slay the murderer;
he has no blood [i.e., he is like one who kills a dead man, who has no blood.]

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י בְעִ֤יר מִקְלָטוֹ֙ יֵשֵׁ֔ב עַד־מ֖וֹת הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֑ל
pairs.english: For in the city of his refuge shall he dwell until the death of the high-priest;

pairs.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹת֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּדֹ֔ל יָשׁוּב֙ הָרֹצֵ֔חַ אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
pairs.english: and after the death of the high-priest, the slayer shall return to the land of his holding.

pairs.hebrew: וְהָי֨וּ אֵ֧לֶּה לָכֶ֛ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּ֖ט לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: And these shall be for you a statute of judgment throughout your generations
in all of your dwellings [A small sanhedrin obtains outside of Eretz Yisrael so long as one obtains in Eretz Yisrael.]
Whoever would kill a soul [because he killed another], by the testimony of witnesses [that he killed wittingly and after having been forewarned] shall he kill the slayer;
and one witness shall not testify against a soul to have him put to death.

pairs.hebrew: וְלֹֽא־תִקְח֥וּ כֹ֙פֶר֙ לְנֶ֣פֶשׁ רֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר־ה֥וּא רָשָׁ֖ע לָמ֑וּת
pairs.english: And you shall not take ransom for the soul of a murderer who is liable to death,
but die shall he die.
And you shall not take ransom for him [who killed unwittingly and] who fled to the city of his refuge,
to return to dwell in the land before the death of the (high-) priest.
And you shall not convict the land in which you are.
For the blood convicts the land,

pairs.hebrew: וְלָאָ֣רֶץ לֹֽא־יְכֻפַּ֗ר לַדָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שֻׁפַּךְ־בָּ֔הּ כִּי־אִ֖ם בְּדַ֥ם שֹׁפְכֽוֹ׃
pairs.english: and the land will not have atonement for the blood that was spilled in it except by the blood of its spiller.

pairs.hebrew: וְלֹ֧א תְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ן בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ
pairs.english: And you shall not defile the land which you inhabit, in which I dwell [(so that you not cause Me to dwell in its uncleanliness)],

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה שֹׁכֵ֕ן בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
pairs.english: for I, the L-rd, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel [even when they are unclean].

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיִּקְרְב֞וּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת לְמִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בְּנֵֽי־גִלְעָד֙ בֶּן־מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה מִֽמִּשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף
pairs.english: And the heads of the fathers of the family of the children of Gilad, the son of Machir the son of Menasheh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, drew near,

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיְדַבְּר֞וּ לִפְנֵ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַנְּשִׂאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
pairs.english: and they spoke before Moses and before the chiefs of the heads of the fathers of the children of Israel.

pairs.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אֶת־אֲדֹנִי֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה לָתֵ֨ת אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֛ה בְּגוֹרָ֖ל לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
pairs.english: And they said: The L-rd commanded my lord to give the land in inheritance by lot to the children of Israel.

pairs.hebrew: וַֽאדֹנִי֙ צֻוָּ֣ה בַֽיהֹוָ֔ה לָתֵ֗ת אֶֽת־נַחֲלַ֛ת צְלׇפְחָ֥ד אָחִ֖ינוּ לִבְנֹתָֽיו׃
pairs.english: And my lord was commanded by the L-rd to give the inheritance of Tzelafchad our brother to his daughters.

pairs.hebrew: וְ֠הָי֠וּ לְאֶחָ֞ד מִבְּנֵ֨י שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְנָשִׁים֒
pairs.english: And if they become wives to any of the sons of the (other) tribes of the children of Israel,

pairs.hebrew: וְנִגְרְעָ֤ה נַחֲלָתָן֙ מִנַּחֲלַ֣ת אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ וְנוֹסַ֕ף עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָהֶ֑ם
pairs.english: then their inheritance will be diminished from the inheritance of our fathers and it will be added onto the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry, [for their sons will inherit them, and the sons are of the father's tribe],
and from the lot of our inheritance will it be diminished.

And [even] when the Jubilee obtains for the children of Israel, [when sold land (as opposed to an inheritance) reverts to its original owner — Even when the Jubilee obtains (the implication being that it is destined to cease for a time)],

pairs.hebrew: וְנֽוֹסְפָה֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔ן עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַמַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָהֶ֑ם
pairs.english: their inheritance shall be added onto the inheritance of the tribe to which they are wed,
and from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers their inheritance will be diminished!

pairs.hebrew: וַיְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל־פִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר
pairs.english: And Moses commanded the children of Israel by the word of the L-rd saying:
Rightly does the tribe of the sons of Joseph speak.

pairs.hebrew: זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֗ה לִבְנ֤וֹת צְלׇפְחָד֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר
pairs.english: This is the thing that the L-rd has commanded respecting the daughters of Tzelafchad, saying:
To whom it is pleasing in their eyes shall they be as wives;

pairs.hebrew: אַ֗ךְ לְמִשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אֲבִיהֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לְנָשִֽׁים׃
pairs.english: but to the family of the tribe of their father shall they be as wives.

pairs.hebrew: וְלֹֽא־תִסֹּ֤ב נַחֲלָה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִמַּטֶּ֖ה אֶל־מַטֶּ֑ה
pairs.english: And an inheritance of the children of Israel shall not go around from tribe to tribe,

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י אִ֗ישׁ בְּנַחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֔יו יִדְבְּק֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
pairs.english: but each, to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers, shall the children of Israel cleave.

pairs.hebrew: וְכׇל־בַּ֞ת יֹרֶ֣שֶׁת נַחֲלָ֗ה מִמַּטּוֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒
pairs.english: And every daughter who receives an inheritance from the tribes of the children of Israel, [(her father having had no son)],

pairs.hebrew: לְאֶחָ֗ד מִמִּשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖יהָ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְאִשָּׁ֑ה
pairs.english: to one of the family of the tribe of her father shall she be as a wife,

pairs.hebrew: לְמַ֗עַן יִֽירְשׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
pairs.english: so that the children of Israel will inherit, each, the inheritance of his fathers.
And an inheritance shall not go around from one tribe to a different tribe,

pairs.hebrew: כִּי־אִישׁ֙ בְּנַ֣חֲלָת֔וֹ יִדְבְּק֕וּ מַטּ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
pairs.english: but each to his inheritance shall cleave, the tribes of the children of Israel.
As the L-rd commanded Moses,
thus did the daughters of Tzelafchad.

pairs.hebrew: וַתִּהְיֶ֜ינָה מַחְלָ֣ה תִרְצָ֗ה וְחׇגְלָ֧ה וּמִלְכָּ֛ה וְנֹעָ֖ה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלׇפְחָ֑ד
pairs.english: And Machlah, Tirtzah, Chaglah, Milkah, and Noah, the daughters of Tzelafchad,

became wives to the sons of their uncles. [Here they are reckoned in order of their seniority, in which order they wed, whereas elsewhere they are reckoned in order of wisdom (whence it is to be derived that they are to be regarded as equals)].
(To men) of the families of the sons of Joseph were they wives,
so that their inheritance reverted to the tribe of the family of their father.

pairs.hebrew: אֵ֣לֶּה הַמִּצְוֺ֞ת וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
pairs.english: These are the mitzvoth and the judgments that the L-rd commanded through Moses to the children of Israel
in the plains of Moav by the Jordan (near) Jericho.

pairs.hebrew: אֵ֣לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן
pairs.english: These are the words which Moses spoke [(Because they are words of reproof and he enumerated here all of the places where they angered the L-rd, he speaks only by way of allusion out of regard for the honor of Israel)] to all of Israel [(Had he spoken only to some of them, the others might have contended that were they there they could have countered the rebuke)] across the Jordan,

concerning [their angering the L-rd in] the desert [(viz. Exodus 16:3)], concerning the plain [(their sinning through Ba'al Peor in Shittim, in the plains of Moav)], against Suf [i.e., concerning their rebelling against the L-rd at Suf (the Red Sea), (Exodus 14:11)],

pairs.hebrew: בֵּֽין־פָּארָ֧ן וּבֵֽין־תֹּ֛פֶל וְלָבָ֥ן וַחֲצֵרֹ֖ת וְדִ֥י זָהָֽב׃
pairs.english: concerning [what they had done in the desert of] Paran [through the spies], and concerning [their] calumniating [the manna, saying that it was] white [i.e., "flimsy" (see Numbers 21:5)], and [concerning] Chatzeroth [the (encampment of the) Korach insurrection], and [concerning the golden calf that they made because of their] abundance of gold.

pairs.hebrew: אַחַ֨ד עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ מֵֽחֹרֵ֔ב דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַר־שֵׂעִ֑יר
pairs.english: [There is no shorter route from Chorev to Kadesh Barnea than that by way of Mount Seir, it taking] eleven days from Chorev by way of Mount Seir

until Kadesh Barnea [and the L-rd, in His desire to hasten your entry into Eretz Yisrael, caused you to traverse it in three days; but because of your backsliding He led you around Mount Seir for forty years.]

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיְהִי֙ בְּאַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּעַשְׁתֵּֽי־עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ
pairs.english: And it was, in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month,
that Moses spoke to the children of Israel

pairs.hebrew: כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
pairs.english: according to all that the L-rd commanded him concerning them, [Moses reproving them only shortly before his death (taking Jacob as his precedent, who reproved his sons only shortly before his death)],

pairs.hebrew: אַחֲרֵ֣י הַכֹּת֗וֹ אֵ֚ת סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן
pairs.english: [Moses reproving them only] after he had smitten Sichon, king of the Emori, [(reasoning that if he reproved them before entering (at least) part of the land they might regard the reproof as an excuse for his inability to take it)], who dwelt in Cheshbon ["a hard king living in a hard place" — in spite of which Moses defeated him!],

pairs.hebrew: וְאֵ֗ת ע֚וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר־יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּעַשְׁתָּרֹ֖ת בְּאֶדְרֶֽעִי׃
pairs.english: and Og, the king of Bashan, who dwelt in Ashtaroth [lit., "hardness" (again, "a hard king in a hard place")], in Edrei [(the name of the kingdom)].
Across the Jordan, in the land of Moav,

pairs.hebrew: הוֹאִ֣יל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֵּאֵ֛ר אֶת־הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לֵאמֹֽר׃
pairs.english: Moses began to explain this Torah [in seventy languages], saying:

pairs.hebrew: יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵ֖ינוּ בְּחֹרֵ֣ב לֵאמֹ֑ר
pairs.english: The L-rd our G-d spoke to us in Chorev, saying:
You have dwelt in this mountain long enough.

pairs.hebrew: פְּנ֣וּ ׀ וּסְע֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם וּבֹ֨אוּ הַ֥ר הָֽאֱמֹרִי֮ וְאֶל־כׇּל־שְׁכֵנָיו֒
pairs.english: Turn and journey [the way to Arad and Charmah] and come to the mountain of the Emori and to all of its neighbors [Ammon, Moav, and Mount Seir],

pairs.hebrew: בָּעֲרָבָ֥ה בָהָ֛ר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֥ה וּבַנֶּ֖גֶב וּבְח֣וֹף הַיָּ֑ם
pairs.english: in the plain [the forest plain], in the mountain [the "King's Mountain" (see Gittin 57a)], in the lowland [of the south], in the south and by the seacoast [Ashkelon, Azzah, Caesarea, etc.],

pairs.hebrew: אֶ֤רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַלְּבָנ֔וֹן עַד־הַנָּהָ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל נְהַר־פְּרָֽת׃
pairs.english: the land of the Canaani and the Levanon, until the Great River, the Euphrates [(called the "Great River" because of its being mentioned in conjunction with Eretz Yisrael)].
See, [with your own eyes], I have set the land before you.
Come and possess the land [No one will contest your doing so; you will need no recourse to war (Had they not sent the spies, they would not have needed weapons)],

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֣ע יְ֠הֹוָ֠ה לַאֲבֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֔ם וּלְזַרְעָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
pairs.english: which the L-rd swore to your fathers: to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob [(Each was worthy of it in himself)], to give to them and to their seed after them.
And I said to you at that time, saying [at the behest of the L-rd]:
I shall not be able to bear you [i.e., to judge you] alone,
[For] the L-rd your G-d has elevated you [over your judges (making them accountable for the punishment they impose upon you)],
and, behold, you are [like] the day, [i.e., enduring forever like the sun and the constellations], like the stars of the heavens in multitude.

pairs.hebrew: יְהֹוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֽוֹתֵכֶ֗ם יֹסֵ֧ף עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם כָּכֶ֖ם אֶ֣לֶף פְּעָמִ֑ים
pairs.english: May the L-rd, the G-d of your fathers, add to you, such as you, a thousand times! [(At this point, Israel objects: "Would you limit our blessing when the L-rd has blessed us boundlessly (Genesis 13:16)!" Moses replies: "That was my blessing")],
and let Him bless you [boundlessly] as He spoke to you!
How can I bear alone [see 9]
your contentiousness, your heresy [against your judges], and your caviling!

pairs.hebrew: הָב֣וּ לָ֠כֶ֠ם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים חֲכָמִ֧ים וּנְבֹנִ֛ים וִידֻעִ֖ים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: Ready yourselves (to appoint) [upright, desirable] men: wise, understanding [one thing from another], and known [i.e., familiar to you] among your tribes,
and I shall set them at your heads [to be honored, respected, and feared by you.]
And you answered me, and you said:
Good is the thing that you have spoken to do [(for if we have many judges, we can use a gift to "get on the good side" of those who don't know us!) — this, instead of beseeching me to judge you!]

pairs.hebrew: וָאֶקַּ֞ח אֶת־רָאשֵׁ֣י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֗ם אֲנָשִׁ֤ים חֲכָמִים֙ וִֽידֻעִ֔ים
pairs.english: And I "took" [with words of suasion] the heads of your tribes, men, wise and known [(but I could not find "understanding" ones)],
and I made them heads over you [that you honor them and give them precedence in all matters]:

pairs.hebrew: שָׂרֵ֨י אֲלָפִ֜ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֗וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֤י חֲמִשִּׁים֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י עֲשָׂרֹ֔ת וְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: officers of thousands, [one for a thousand], officers of hundreds, [one for a hundred], officers of fifties, and officers of tens, and [I appointed] bailiffs [over you, to enforce the decisions of the judges] for your tribes.

And I charged your judges [to be deliberate in judgment (regardless of how many times an identical case comes up before them)] at that time, [impressing upon them that they were no longer "free agents," but subservient to the public]:
Hear among your brothers,

pairs.hebrew: וּשְׁפַטְתֶּ֣ם צֶ֔דֶק בֵּֽין־אִ֥ישׁ וּבֵין־אָחִ֖יו וּבֵ֥ין גֵּרֽוֹ׃
pairs.english: and judge righteously between a man and his brother and his opponent.

pairs.hebrew: לֹֽא־תַכִּ֨ירוּ פָנִ֜ים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט כַּקָּטֹ֤ן כַּגָּדֹל֙ תִּשְׁמָע֔וּן
pairs.english: Do not play favorites in judgment [i.e., in appointing judges]. You shall hear [i.e., you shall attach as much importance to] a small [case] as [to] a large one.

pairs.hebrew: לֹ֤א תָג֙וּרוּ֙ מִפְּנֵי־אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֥י הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט לֵאלֹהִ֣ים ה֑וּא
pairs.english: Do not fear any man, for the judgment is G-d's [(You "burden" Him with returning what you take from one unlawfully in judgment.)]

pairs.hebrew: וְהַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְשֶׁ֣ה מִכֶּ֔ם תַּקְרִב֥וּן אֵלַ֖י וּשְׁמַעְתִּֽיו׃
pairs.english: And the thing that is too difficult for you, you shall bring near to me and I shall hear it [(— for which "presumptuousness" the judgment in the instance of the daughters of Tzelafchad (Numbers 27:5) evaded Moses)].
And I charged you at that time
with all the things that you shall do [(regarding the ten differences between monetary and capital litigations (see Sanhedrin 32a)].

pairs.hebrew: וַנִּסַּ֣ע מֵחֹרֵ֗ב וַנֵּ֡לֶךְ אֵ֣ת כׇּל־הַמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַגָּדוֹל֩ וְהַנּוֹרָ֨א הַה֜וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְאִיתֶ֗ם
pairs.english: And we journeyed from Chorev and we went through all the great and fearful desert [(containing gigantic snakes and scorpions)] that you saw,

pairs.hebrew: דֶּ֚רֶךְ הַ֣ר הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֹתָ֑נוּ
pairs.english: by way of the mountain of the Emori, as the L-rd our G-d commanded us,
and we came to Kadesh Barnea.
And I said to you:

pairs.hebrew: בָּאתֶם֙ עַד־הַ֣ר הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃
pairs.english: You have come to the mountain of the Emori, which the L-rd our G-d gives to us.

pairs.hebrew: רְ֠אֵ֠ה נָתַ֨ן יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ
pairs.english: See, the L-rd your G-d has set the land before you;

pairs.hebrew: עֲלֵ֣ה רֵ֗שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ
pairs.english: go up and possess it, as the L-rd, the G-d of your fathers, has spoken to you.
Do not fear and do not be broken.
And all of you drew near to me ["promiscuously" (as opposed to (5:20): "And you approached me [deferentially], all the heads of your tribes and your elders, etc.")], and you said:
Let us send out men before us and let them spy out the land for us.

pairs.hebrew: וְיָשִׁ֤בוּ אֹתָ֙נוּ֙ דָּבָ֔ר אֶת־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲלֶה־בָּ֔הּ וְאֵת֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָבֹ֖א אֲלֵיהֶֽן׃
pairs.english: And let them return to us word [concerning the languages that they speak], the [straightest] way by which we should go up, and the cities to which we will come [first, to conquer].
And the thing was good in my eyes [i.e., I acceded to your request in the hope that my doing so would enhearten you to waive the sending of the spies — but it did not],

pairs.hebrew: וָאֶקַּ֤ח מִכֶּם֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לַשָּֽׁבֶט׃
pairs.english: and I took of you [(from the most select of you)] twelve men, one man to a tribe [(the tribe of Levi not being with them)].

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּפְנוּ֙ וַיַּעֲל֣וּ הָהָ֔רָה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכֹּ֑ל
pairs.english: And they turned and they went up to the mountain, and they came to the river-bed of Eshkol [so called by reason of the cluster (eshkol) of grapes they were to take from there],
and they spied it out, [traversing its boundaries, length and width (see Numbers 13:21)].

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּקְח֤וּ בְיָדָם֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיּוֹרִ֖דוּ אֵלֵ֑ינוּ
pairs.english: And they took in their hand from the fruit of the land and they brought it down to us [(whence it is seen that Eretz Yisrael is higher than all of the other lands)],
and they returned word to us, and they [Joshua and Calev] said:

pairs.hebrew: טוֹבָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃
pairs.english: Good is the land that the L-rd our G-d gives us.
And you did not desire to go up,
and you opposed the word of the L-rd your G-d.
And you caviled in your tents, and you said:

pairs.hebrew: בְּשִׂנְאַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ אֹתָ֔נוּ הוֹצִיאָ֖נוּ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם
pairs.english: In the L-rd's hatred of us [("As you are disposed to another, you think he is disposed to you!")] He took us out of the land of Egypt [(from a fertile land to an arid land)]
to deliver us into the hands of the Emori to destroy us.

pairs.hebrew: אָנָ֣ה ׀ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ עֹלִ֗ים אַחֵ֩ינוּ֩ הֵמַ֨סּוּ אֶת־לְבָבֵ֜נוּ לֵאמֹ֗ר
pairs.english: Whither are we going up? Our brothers have melted our hearts, saying:

pairs.hebrew: עַ֣ם גָּד֤וֹל וָרָם֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וּבְצוּרֹ֖ת בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם
pairs.english: A people greater and higher than we; cities great and fortified in heaven [(Scripture speaks hyperbolically here)],
and also giants did we see there.
And I said to them:
Do not break and do not fear them.
