pairs.hebrew: יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם ה֖וּא יִלָּחֵ֣ם לָכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: The L-rd your G-d who goes before you — He will war for you,

pairs.hebrew: כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֧ה אִתְּכֶ֛ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: as all that He did with you in Egypt before your eyes.

pairs.hebrew: וּבַמִּדְבָּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נְשָׂאֲךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ
pairs.english: And [as all that He did with you] in the desert, where you saw how the L-rd your G-d bore you,
as a man bears his son [(see Exodus 14:19-20)],

pairs.hebrew: בְּכׇל־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם עַד־בֹּאֲכֶ֖ם עַד־הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: in all the way that you went until you came to this place.
And in this thing [that He promises to bring you to the land]
you do not believe in the L-rd your G-d!

pairs.hebrew: הַהֹלֵ֨ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֜ם בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ לָת֥וּר לָכֶ֛ם מָק֖וֹם לַחֲנֹֽתְכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: Who goes before you on the way, to seek out for you a place for your encampment —

pairs.hebrew: בָּאֵ֣שׁ ׀ לַ֗יְלָה לַרְאֹֽתְכֶם֙ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־בָ֔הּ
pairs.english: in fire by night to show you the way wherein you should go,
and in cloud by day!
And the L-rd heard the voice of your words
and He was wroth, and He swore, saying:

pairs.hebrew: אִם־יִרְאֶ֥ה אִישׁ֙ בָּאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַדּ֥וֹר הָרָ֖ע הַזֶּ֑ה אֵ֚ת הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה
pairs.english: No man of these men, this evil generation, shall see the good land
that I swore to give to their forefathers.
Except Calev the son of Yefuneh — he shall see it,
and to him shall I give the land whereon he trod [i.e., Chevron (see Numbers 13:22)], and to his sons,
because he filled [his heart to follow] after the L-rd.
Against me, too, was the L-rd wroth because of you, saying:
You, too, shall not come there.

pairs.hebrew: יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן־נוּן֙ הָעֹמֵ֣ד לְפָנֶ֔יךָ ה֖וּא יָ֣בֹא שָׁ֑מָּה
pairs.english: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you — he shall come there;
him shall you strengthen,
for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

pairs.hebrew: וְטַפְּכֶם֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֜ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֗ה וּ֠בְנֵיכֶ֠ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יָדְע֤וּ הַיּוֹם֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע
pairs.english: And your little ones, of whom you said that they would fall spoil, and your sons, who do not know this day good and evil —
they will come there
and to them will I give it, and they will inherit it.
And you, turn you back, [instead of going directly north through the land of Edom as originally intended]

and go through the desert in the direction of the Red Sea, [to the point of the exodus from Egypt, in the southwest corner (for the desert in which they were traveling was south of Mount Seir, between the Red Sea and Mount Seir. Now they were told to go back to the sea and to travel all around the south of Mount Seir from west to east.)]
And you answered and you said to me: We have sinned to the L-rd.

pairs.hebrew: אֲנַ֤חְנוּ נַעֲלֶה֙ וְנִלְחַ֔מְנוּ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖נוּ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ
pairs.english: We shall go up and do battle according to all that the L-rd our G-d commanded us,

pairs.hebrew: וַֽתַּחְגְּר֗וּ אִ֚ישׁ אֶת־כְּלֵ֣י מִלְחַמְתּ֔וֹ וַתָּהִ֖ינוּ לַעֲלֹ֥ת הָהָֽרָה׃
pairs.english: and you girded, each, his weapons of war, and you readied yourselves to go up to the mountain.
And the L-rd said to me: Say to them:

pairs.hebrew: לֹ֤א תַֽעֲלוּ֙ וְלֹא־תִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י אֵינֶ֖נִּי בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: Do not go up and do not do battle, for I am not in your midst,
and do not be smitten before your foes.
And I spoke to you, but you did not hearken.
And you opposed the word of the L-rd,
and you ventured, and you went up to the mountain.

pairs.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵ֨א הָאֱמֹרִ֜י הַיֹּשֵׁ֨ב בָּהָ֤ר הַהוּא֙ לִקְרַאתְכֶ֔ם
pairs.english: And the Emori went out, who dwelt in that mountain, against you,
and they pursued you, as the bees do [(dying when they smote you, just as a bee dies when it stings)],
and they smote you from Seir until Charmah.
And you turned back and you cried before the L-rd;

pairs.hebrew: וְלֹֽא־שָׁמַ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ בְּקֹ֣לְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א הֶאֱזִ֖ין אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: but the L-rd [Yod-Keh-Vav-Keh, the attribute of mercy] did not heed your voice [(You transformed, as it were, His attribute of mercy to one of cruelty)], and He did not give ear to you.
And you abode in Kadesh many days (i.e., years),
as the days that you abode [in all the other places (Israel wandering aimlessly in the desert for nineteen years before returning to Kadesh)].

pairs.hebrew: וַנֵּ֜פֶן וַנִּסַּ֤ע הַמִּדְבָּ֙רָה֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יַם־ס֔וּף כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י
pairs.english: And we turned back and we traveled through the desert in the direction of the Red Sea, as the L-rd had spoken to me.
And we went around Mount Seir [the entire south side until the land of Moav], many days.
And the L-rd said
to me:
You have gone around this mountain long enough —
turn to the north [to the east of Moav].
And the people, charge, saying:

pairs.hebrew: אַתֶּ֣ם עֹֽבְרִ֗ים בִּגְבוּל֙ אֲחֵיכֶ֣ם בְּנֵי־עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר
pairs.english: You are to pass through the boundary of your brothers, the sons of Esav, who dwell in Seir.
They shall fear you; and take great heed:
Do not incite them:

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֠י לֹֽא־אֶתֵּ֤ן לָכֶם֙ מֵֽאַרְצָ֔ם עַ֖ד מִדְרַ֣ךְ כַּף־רָ֑גֶל
pairs.english: For I shall not allow you [to pass through] their land [without their consent] as much as the space of a footstep,
for as an inheritance to Esav have I given the mountain of Seir.
Food shall you buy of them with money, and you shall eat;
and also water shall you buy of them with money, and you shall drink.

pairs.hebrew: כִּי֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ בֵּֽרַכְךָ֗ בְּכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔ךָ
pairs.english: For the L-rd your G-d has blessed you in all the work of your hand [(Therefore, do not manifest ingratitude for His bounty by showing yourselves poor, but show yourselves rich)].
He knew (i.e., provided for) your going through this vast desert.

pairs.hebrew: זֶ֣ה ׀ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ עִמָּ֔ךְ לֹ֥א חָסַ֖רְתָּ דָּבָֽר׃
pairs.english: These forty years the L-rd your G-d has been with you; you have lacked nothing.

pairs.hebrew: וַֽנַּעֲבֹ֞ר מֵאֵ֧ת אַחֵ֣ינוּ בְנֵי־עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר
pairs.english: And we passed from our brothers, the sons of Esav, who dwelt in Seir,
by way of the plain, from Eilath and from Etzyon Gaver.
And we turned [north] and we passed by the desert of Moav, [proceeding on the eastern side].

pairs.hebrew: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אַל־תָּ֙צַר֙ אֶת־מוֹאָ֔ב וְאַל־תִּתְגָּ֥ר בָּ֖ם מִלְחָמָ֑ה
pairs.english: And the L-rd said to me: Do not besiege Moav and do not incite a war against them;
for I shall not give to you of his land as an inheritance;
for to the children of Lot have I given Ar [(the province)] as an inheritance.
The Eimim [so called because men were in dread (eimah) of them] had dwelt there formerly,
a people, great, many, and lofty, like the Anakim, [but this is not the land of Refaim that I promised to Abraham (Genesis 15:20)],
For they, [the Eimim], too, are reckoned refaim [(giants) so called because the hands of all who see them are "weakened" (mithrapoth)], like the Anakim, [who are called "refaim"];
and the Moavites called them "Eimim." [And I drove out the Eimim-Refaim and placed the children of Lot in their place].
And, [likewise,] in Seir, the Chorim dwelt formerly,

pairs.hebrew: וּבְנֵ֧י עֵשָׂ֣ו יִֽירָשׁ֗וּם וַיַּשְׁמִידוּם֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ תַּחְתָּ֑ם
pairs.english: and the sons of Esav would drive them out and destroy them before them, and they dwelt in their place,

pairs.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר עָשָׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְאֶ֙רֶץ֙ יְרֻשָּׁת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן יְהֹוָ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃
pairs.english: as Israel did in the land of its inheritance, which the L-rd gave to them.

pairs.hebrew: עַתָּ֗ה קֻ֛מוּ וְעִבְר֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־נַ֣חַל זָ֑רֶד
pairs.english: Now, arise and cross over the stream of Zared.
And we crossed over the stream of Zared.

pairs.hebrew: וְהַיָּמִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־הָלַ֣כְנוּ ׀ מִקָּדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֗עַ עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר־עָבַ֙רְנוּ֙ אֶת־נַ֣חַל זֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה
pairs.english: And the days which we went from Kadesh Barnea until we crossed the stream of Zared were thirty-eight years,

pairs.hebrew: עַד־תֹּ֨ם כׇּל־הַדּ֜וֹר אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ מִקֶּ֣רֶב הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה
pairs.english: until the end of all the generation of the men of war from the midst of the camp,
as the L-rd swore to them.
And the hand of the L-rd was against them, too,
to [hasten to] confound them from the midst of the camp until their end [within the forty years, so that their children be detained no longer in the desert.]
And it was, when all the men of war [(those from the age of twenty)] had finished dying
from amidst the people,

That the L-rd spoke (vayedaber) to me, [the L-rd not having spoken to me directly and affectionately (this being the connotation of "vayedaber") all those years from the sending of the spies until now],
saying:
You are passing this day
the border of Moav, Ar.
And you shall draw opposite the children of Ammon [(whence it is seen that Ammon is to the north of Moav)].

Do not besiege them and do not incite them [at all (not only to war, as in the instance of Moav (9), this in reward for the modesty of their progenitor (the younger daughter of Lot, who, (unlike her sister) in naming her child concealed the fact that she had begotten him from her father (see Genesis 19:37-38)].

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י לֹֽא־אֶ֠תֵּ֠ן מֵאֶ֨רֶץ בְּנֵי־עַמּ֤וֹן לְךָ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י לִבְנֵי־ל֖וֹט נְתַתִּ֥יהָ יְרֻשָּֽׁה׃
pairs.english: For I shall not give you of the land of the children of Ammon as an inheritance. For to the children of Lot have I given it as an inheritance.
That, too, was reckoned a land of refaim,

pairs.hebrew: רְפָאִ֤ים יָֽשְׁבוּ־בָהּ֙ לְפָנִ֔ים וְהָֽעַמֹּנִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם זַמְזֻמִּֽים׃
pairs.english: [for] refaim dwelt there formerly (and the Ammonites called them zamzumim) [but this is not the land of the Refaim that I promised to Abraham],
A people, great, many, and lofty, like the Anakim.

pairs.hebrew: וַיַּשְׁמִידֵ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּירָשֻׁ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃
pairs.english: And the L-rd destroyed them before them (the Ammonites), and they drove them out and dwelt in their place.

pairs.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לִבְנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּשֵׂעִ֑יר
pairs.english: As He did for the sons of Esav, who dwell in Seir,
destroying the Chori before them.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּֽירָשֻׁם֙ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ תַחְתָּ֔ם עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: And they [progressively] drove them out, and they dwell in their place until this day.
And the Avim [Philistines], who dwelt in Chatzerim as far as Azzah [— Although by Abraham's oath to Avimelech, king of the Philistines, (Genesis 21:24), it would not be permitted to take their land],

pairs.hebrew: כַּפְתֹּרִים֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים מִכַּפְתֹּ֔ר הִשְׁמִידֻ֖ם וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽם׃
pairs.english: Kaftorim, who came out of Kaftor destroyed them [the Avim] and dwelt in their place, [so that it is now permitted to take that land.]
Arise, journey, and cross the stream of Arnon.

pairs.hebrew: רְאֵ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּי בְ֠יָדְךָ֠ אֶת־סִיחֹ֨ן מֶֽלֶךְ־חֶשְׁבּ֧וֹן הָֽאֱמֹרִ֛י וְאֶת־אַרְצ֖וֹ
pairs.english: See, I have given in your hand Sichon, the king of Cheshbon, the Emori, and his land.
Begin to drive (him) out, and incite a war against him.

pairs.hebrew: הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ תֵּ֤ת פַּחְדְּךָ֙ וְיִרְאָ֣תְךָ֔ עַל־פְּנֵי֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כׇּל־הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם
pairs.english: This day I shall begin to place your awe and your fear upon the face of the peoples under all the heavens,

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁמְעוּן֙ שִׁמְעֲךָ֔ וְרָגְז֥וּ וְחָל֖וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
pairs.english: who will hear of your renown, and who will tremble and shudder before you [(whence it is derived that the sun stood still for Moses in this battle and it became known "under all the heavens.")]

pairs.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר קְדֵמ֔וֹת אֶל־סִיח֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן
pairs.english: And I sent messengers from the desert of Kedemoth [Sinai] to Sichon, king of Moav,

(with) words of peace [(Though I was not commanded to seek peace with Sichon, I learned from the Torah (given at Sinai), which preceded (kadmah) the world (hence "kedemoth") to pursue peace, the Holy One Blessed be He (in pursuit of peace) offering the Torah to all of the other nations, though He knew they would not accept it, before He gave it to Israel)], saying:
Let me pass through your land.
I will go only by the (main) road;
I will turn neither right nor left.
You shall sell me food for money and I shall eat;
and water for money shall you give me and I shall drink.
Only let me pass through on my feet.

pairs.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עָֽשׂוּ־לִ֜י בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֵׂעִ֔יר וְהַמּ֣וֹאָבִ֔ים הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּעָ֑ר
pairs.english: As there did for me [re food and drink] the sons of Esav, who dwell in Seir, and the Moavites, who dwell in Ar,

pairs.hebrew: עַ֤ד אֲשֶֽׁר־אֶֽעֱבֹר֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃
pairs.english: until I cross the Jordan to the land that the L-rd our G-d is giving us.

pairs.hebrew: וְלֹ֣א אָבָ֗ה סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַעֲבִרֵ֖נוּ בּ֑וֹ
pairs.english: But Sichon the king of Cheshbon would not allow us to pass through him.

pairs.hebrew: כִּֽי־הִקְשָׁה֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־רוּח֗וֹ וְאִמֵּץ֙ אֶת־לְבָב֔וֹ
pairs.english: For the L-rd your G-d hardened his spirit and fortified his heart,
to deliver him into your hand as of this day.
And the L-rd said to me:

pairs.hebrew: רְאֵ֗ה הַֽחִלֹּ֙תִי֙ תֵּ֣ת לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶת־סִיחֹ֖ן וְאֶת־אַרְצ֑וֹ
pairs.english: See, I have begun to give before you Sichon and his land [(He lowered the tutelary angel of the Emorites beneath Moses' feet and had them tread on his neck)].
Begin to drive (him) out, to inherit his land.
And Sichon went out against us, [(not sending to Og for assistance, each being "self-sufficient")],
he and all his people, to war, to Yahatz.
And the L-rd our G-d delivered him before us,
and we smote him and his sons [(The written form is "son" — he had a son as mighty as he)], and all his people.
And we conquered all of his cities at that time.
And we laid waste the entire city: men, women, and children;
we left no remnant.
Only the beasts did we take for ourselves,
and the spoil of the cities which we conquered.

pairs.hebrew: מֵֽעֲרֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־שְׂפַת־נַ֨חַל אַרְנֹ֜ן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּנַּ֙חַל֙ וְעַד־הַגִּלְעָ֔ד
pairs.english: From Aroer, by the bank of the stream of Arnon and the city by the stream until Gilead.

pairs.hebrew: לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂגְבָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נּוּ
pairs.english: There was no city which was too formidable for us.
All, the L-rd our G-d delivered before us.
Only to the land of the children of Ammon did you not come near.

pairs.hebrew: כׇּל־יַ֞ד נַ֤חַל יַבֹּק֙ וְעָרֵ֣י הָהָ֔ר וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֖ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
pairs.english: All [that is] alongside the stream of Yabbok and the cities of the mountain, and all that the L-rd our G-d commanded [not to conquer, we left alone.]
And we turned and we went up [northwards, in an ascent] by way of the Bashan,

pairs.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵ֣א עוֹג֩ מֶֽלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁ֨ן לִקְרָאתֵ֜נוּ ה֧וּא וְכׇל־עַמּ֛וֹ לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֶדְרֶֽעִי׃
pairs.english: and Og the king of Bashan went out against us, he and all of his people, to war in Edrei.
And the L-rd said to me: Do not fear him [(Moses needing this reassurance in view of Og's having abetted Abraham (see Genesis 14:13 and Numbers 21:34)],

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י בְיָדְךָ֞ נָתַ֧תִּי אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־כׇּל־עַמּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־אַרְצ֑וֹ
pairs.english: for in your hand have I given him and all of his people and his land.

pairs.hebrew: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ לְסִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃
pairs.english: And you shall do to him as you did to Sichon king of the Emori who dwelt in Cheshbon.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֜ינוּ בְּיָדֵ֗נוּ גַּ֛ם אֶת־ע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁ֖ן וְאֶת־כׇּל־עַמּ֑וֹ
pairs.english: And the L-rd our G-d gave into our hands also Og the king of Bashan and all his people.
And we smote him until there did not remain of him a remnant.
And we conquered all of his cities at that time.

pairs.hebrew: לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־לָקַ֖חְנוּ מֵֽאִתָּ֑ם
pairs.english: There was not a city which we did not take from them:

pairs.hebrew: שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִיר֙ כׇּל־חֶ֣בֶל אַרְגֹּ֔ב מַמְלֶ֥כֶת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָֽׁן׃
pairs.english: sixty cities, the entire province of the palace, [the province being named after the palace], the kingdom of Og in the Bashan.

pairs.hebrew: כׇּל־אֵ֜לֶּה עָרִ֧ים בְּצֻרֹ֛ת חוֹמָ֥ה גְבֹהָ֖ה דְּלָתַ֣יִם וּבְרִ֑יחַ
pairs.english: All these, cities fortified with a high wall, doors, and bolt,
aside from very many unwalled cities.

pairs.hebrew: וַנַּחֲרֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ינוּ לְסִיחֹ֖ן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן
pairs.english: And we [progressively] laid them waste, as we did to Sichon king of Cheshbon,
laying waste every city: men, women, and children.
And every beast and the spoil of the cities
we scorned [to take] for ourselves, [being already sated with the plunder of Sichon (2:35)].

pairs.hebrew: וַנִּקַּ֞ח בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִוא֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ מִיַּ֗ד שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן
pairs.english: And we took at that time the land from the rule of the two kings of the Emori across the Jordan,
from the stream of Arnon until Mount Chermon.
The Tziddonim called Chermon Siryon,
and the Emori called it S'nir ["snow" (Chermon had four names, this betokening the excellence of Eretz Yisrael, each of the four kings desiring that it be associated with him)].

pairs.hebrew: כֹּ֣ל ׀ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּישֹׁ֗ר וְכׇל־הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְכׇל־הַבָּשָׁ֔ן עַד־סַלְכָ֖ה וְאֶדְרֶ֑עִי
pairs.english: All the cities of the plain and all of the Gilead and all of the Bashan until Salchah and Edrei,
cities of the kingdom of Og in the Bashan.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י רַק־ע֞וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֗ן נִשְׁאַר֮ מִיֶּ֣תֶר הָרְפָאִים֒
pairs.english: For only Og king of Bashan remained from the rest of the Refaim, [whom Amrafel and his allies killed in Ashteroth Karnayim, Og alone escaping (Genesis 14:5 and 14)].

pairs.hebrew: הִנֵּ֤ה עַרְשׂוֹ֙ עֶ֣רֶשׂ בַּרְזֶ֔ל הֲלֹ֣ה הִ֔וא בְּרַבַּ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן
pairs.english: Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Is it not (to be seen) in Rabbath B'nei Ammon?

pairs.hebrew: תֵּ֧שַׁע אַמּ֣וֹת אׇרְכָּ֗הּ וְאַרְבַּ֥ע אַמּ֛וֹת רׇחְבָּ֖הּ בְּאַמַּת־אִֽישׁ׃
pairs.english: Nine cubits ("forearms") its length and four cubits its breadth in the cubit of a man [i.e., Og].
And this land, [from the stream of Arnon until Mount Chermon (8)] we inherited at that time.

pairs.hebrew: מֵעֲרֹעֵ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־עַל־נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֗ן וַחֲצִ֤י הַֽר־הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעָרָ֔יו נָתַ֕תִּי לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְלַגָּדִֽי׃
pairs.english: From Aroer by the stream of Arnon and half the mountain of Gilead and its cities I gave to the Reuveni and the Gadi.

pairs.hebrew: וְיֶ֨תֶר הַגִּלְעָ֤ד וְכׇל־הַבָּשָׁן֙ מַמְלֶ֣כֶת ע֔וֹג נָתַ֕תִּי לַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֑ה
pairs.english: And the remainder of Gilead and all of Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half tribe of Menasheh,

pairs.hebrew: כֹּ֣ל חֶ֤בֶל הָֽאַרְגֹּב֙ לְכׇל־הַבָּשָׁ֔ן הַה֥וּא יִקָּרֵ֖א אֶ֥רֶץ רְפָאִֽים׃
pairs.english: the entire province of the palace (see 4), with all the Bashan. That is called the land of Refaim [which I promised to Abraham.]

pairs.hebrew: יָאִ֣יר בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לָקַח֙ אֶת־כׇּל־חֶ֣בֶל אַרְגֹּ֔ב עַד־גְּב֥וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְהַמַּֽעֲכָתִ֑י
pairs.english: Yair the son of Menasheh took the entire province of the palace until the boundary of the Geshuri and the Ma'achathi.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא֩ אֹתָ֨ם עַל־שְׁמ֤וֹ אֶת־הַבָּשָׁן֙ חַוֺּ֣ת יָאִ֔יר עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: And he called them by his name — Bashan Chavoth Yair — until this day.
And to Machir
I gave the Gilead.

pairs.hebrew: וְלָראוּבֵנִ֨י וְלַגָּדִ֜י נָתַ֤תִּי מִן־הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעַד־נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֔ן תּ֥וֹךְ הַנַּ֖חַל וּגְבֻ֑ל
pairs.english: And to the Reuveni and the Gadi I gave from the Gilead until the stream of Arnon, the entire stream and more [land beyond the bank],

pairs.hebrew: וְעַד֙ יַבֹּ֣ק הַנַּ֔חַל גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃
pairs.english: and until the stream of Yabbok, the boundary of the children of Ammon.
And the plain and the [width of the] Jordan [opposite Gad, who were on the east side of the Jordan] and more [land],

pairs.hebrew: מִכִּנֶּ֗רֶת וְעַ֨ד יָ֤ם הָֽעֲרָבָה֙ יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לַח תַּ֛חַת אַשְׁדֹּ֥ת הַפִּסְגָּ֖ה מִזְרָֽחָה׃
pairs.english: from the Kinnereth [on the western side of the Jordan], until the sea of the plain, the Salt Sea, beneath Ashdoth Hapisgah to the east.
And I charged you [the sons of Reuven and the sons of Gad] at that time, saying:

pairs.hebrew: יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֗ם נָתַ֨ן לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־הָאָ֤רֶץ הַזֹּאת֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ
pairs.english: The L-rd your G-d has given you this land to inherit.

pairs.hebrew: חֲלוּצִ֣ים תַּֽעַבְר֗וּ לִפְנֵ֛י אֲחֵיכֶ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כׇּל־בְּנֵי־חָֽיִל׃
pairs.english: Armed shall you pass over before your brothers, the children of Israel, all men of war [They were warriors, who humbled the foe (viz. Numbers 32:17)].

pairs.hebrew: רַ֠ק נְשֵׁיכֶ֣ם וְטַפְּכֶם֮ וּמִקְנֵכֶם֒ יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי־מִקְנֶ֥ה רַ֖ב לָכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: Only your wives, your little ones, and your cattle — (for) I know that you have much cattle —
shall abide in your cities which I gave to you.
Until the L-rd gives repose to your brothers as to you,

pairs.hebrew: וְיָרְשׁ֣וּ גַם־הֵ֔ם אֶת־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן
pairs.english: and they, too, inherit the land which the L-rd your G-d gives to you across the Jordan;

pairs.hebrew: וְשַׁבְתֶּ֗ם אִ֚ישׁ לִֽירֻשָּׁת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: and (then) you shall return, each to his inheritance that I have given you.
And Joshua I charged at that time, saying:

pairs.hebrew: עֵינֶ֣יךָ הָרֹאֹ֗ת אֵת֩ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶם֙ לִשְׁנֵי֙ הַמְּלָכִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה
pairs.english: Your eyes that have seen all that the L-rd your G-d did to these two kings —

pairs.hebrew: כֵּֽן־יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ לְכׇל־הַמַּמְלָכ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹבֵ֥ר שָֽׁמָּה׃
pairs.english: thus shall the L-rd do to all of the kingdoms whither you pass.
Do not fear them,
for the L-rd your G-d — it is He who wars for you.
And I entreated (va'ethchanan) the L-rd [lit., I asked a "gratuitous" favor of Him. (I did not "pin" it on my desert)],

at that time [(after I conquered the land of Sichon and Og, thinking that His vow (that I not enter "the land") might thereby have been annulled (the land of Sichon and Og also being reckoned "the land")], saying:

pairs.hebrew: אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה אַתָּ֤ה הַֽחִלּ֙וֹתָ֙ לְהַרְא֣וֹת אֶֽת־עַבְדְּךָ֔ אֶ֨ת־גׇּדְלְךָ֔ וְאֶת־יָדְךָ֖ הַחֲזָקָ֑ה
pairs.english: O L-rd (Yod-Keh-Vav-Keh), G-d (Elokim) [Merciful in Judgment], You began to show Your servant Your greatness and Your strong hand [in the war of Sichon and Og];

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִי־אֵל֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם וּבָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כְמַעֲשֶׂ֖יךָ וְכִגְבוּרֹתֶֽךָ׃
pairs.english: for who is Almighty in the heavens and in the earth to do as Your deeds and as Your strength? [— therefore, show me the war of the thirty-one kings (of Canaan in the conquest of Eretz Yisrael proper)].

pairs.hebrew: אֶעְבְּרָה־נָּ֗א וְאֶרְאֶה֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן
pairs.english: Let me pass over and see, I pray You, the good land across the Jordan,
this good mountain [Jerusalem] and the Levanon [the Temple].

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּתְעַבֵּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֥ה בִּי֙ לְמַ֣עַנְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑י
pairs.english: And the L-rd was wroth with me because of you, and He did not heed me.
And the L-rd said to me: Enough for you!

pairs.hebrew: אַל־תּ֗וֹסֶף דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛י ע֖וֹד בַּדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: Presume to speak to Me no more about this thing [(so that they not say: "How intransigent the Teacher and how importunate the disciple!")]

pairs.hebrew: עֲלֵ֣ה ׀ רֹ֣אשׁ הַפִּסְגָּ֗ה וְשָׂ֥א עֵינֶ֛יךָ יָ֧מָּה וְצָפֹ֛נָה וְתֵימָ֥נָה וּמִזְרָ֖חָה
pairs.english: Go up to the top of the height and lift your eyes west and north and south and east;
and see with your eyes [(You asked to be shown only the good land (25) — I will show you all of it!)],
for you shall not cross this Jordan.

And charge Joshua [concerning their contentiousness, their heresy, and their caviling (1:12)], and strengthen him and hearten him [with your words, that he not lose heart and say: Just as my master was punished because of them (and could not enter the land), so will it be with me],
for [I warrant that] he will pass over before this people

pairs.hebrew: וְהוּא֙ יַנְחִ֣יל אוֹתָ֔ם אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה׃
pairs.english: and he will cause them to inherit the land that you shall see [(If he passes over before them, they will inherit it; if he does not, they will not.)]
And we abode in the valley

opposite Beth Peor [and you succumbed to idolatry — in spite of which (below): "And now, O Israel, hearken to the statutes, etc." and all will be forgiven you, whereas I did not merit such forgiveness!]

pairs.hebrew: וְעַתָּ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁמַ֤ע אֶל־הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְאֶל־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָֽנֹכִ֛י מְלַמֵּ֥ד אֶתְכֶ֖ם לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת
pairs.english: And now, O Israel, hearken to the statutes and to the judgments which I teach you to do,
so that you may live and come and inherit the land

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: which the L-rd, the G-d of your fathers, gives to you.

pairs.hebrew: לֹ֣א תֹסִ֗פוּ עַל־הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם
pairs.english: You shall not add to the thing that I command you [e.g., placing five sections (instead of four) in the tefillin],
and you shall not diminish therefrom,

pairs.hebrew: לִשְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת־מִצְוֺת֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: to heed the mitzvoth of the L-rd your G-d, which I command you.

pairs.hebrew: עֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ הָֽרֹא֔וֹת אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר
pairs.english: (For it is) your (own) eyes that have seen what the L-rd did with (the worshippers of) Ba'al Peor.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י כׇל־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בַֽעַל־פְּע֔וֹר הִשְׁמִיד֛וֹ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃
pairs.english: For every man that went after Ba'al Peor — the L-rd your G-d destroyed him from your midst.
But you who cleaved to the L-rd your G-d
are all alive this day.
See, I have taught you statutes and judgments
as the L-rd my G-d commanded me,

pairs.hebrew: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן בְּקֶ֣רֶב הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם בָּאִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
pairs.english: to do thus in the midst of the land whither you come to inherit it.
And you shall heed [This is mishnah (learning)], and you shall do [what you have learned].

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י הִ֤וא חׇכְמַתְכֶם֙ וּבִ֣ינַתְכֶ֔ם לְעֵינֵ֖י הָעַמִּ֑ים
pairs.english: For this is your wisdom and your understanding [i.e., You will thereby be accounted wise and understanding] in the eyes of the peoples,

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֚ת כׇּל־הַחֻקִּ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְאָמְר֗וּ רַ֚ק עַם־חָכָ֣ם וְנָב֔וֹן הַגּ֥וֹי הַגָּד֖וֹל הַזֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: who will hear of all these statutes and who will say: Surely, a wise and understanding people is this great nation.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֚י מִי־ג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ל֥וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קְרֹבִ֣ים אֵלָ֑יו
pairs.english: For who is a great nation which has a G-d near to it
as the L-rd our G-d in all of our calling to Him?

pairs.hebrew: וּמִי֙ גּ֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר־ל֛וֹ חֻקִּ֥ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים צַדִּיקִ֑ם
pairs.english: And who is a great nation which has righteous statutes and judgments

pairs.hebrew: כְּכֹל֙ הַתּוֹרָ֣ה הַזֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
pairs.english: as all of this Torah which I place before you this day?

pairs.hebrew: רַ֡ק הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֩ וּשְׁמֹ֨ר נַפְשְׁךָ֜ מְאֹ֗ד
pairs.english: Only take heed to yourself, and heed your soul exceedingly,

pairs.hebrew: פֶּן־תִּשְׁכַּ֨ח אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וּפֶן־יָס֙וּרוּ֙ מִלְּבָ֣בְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ
pairs.english: lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life. [Only if you do not forget them and do them as prescribed will you be thought wise and understanding; but if you distort them through forgetfulness, you will be accounted foolish.]
And you shall impart them to your sons and to the sons of your sons.

pairs.hebrew: י֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָמַ֜דְתָּ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֘יךָ֮ בְּחֹרֵב֒ בֶּאֱמֹ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י
pairs.english: ["Lest you forget the things (the sounds and the lightnings) which your eyes saw" on] the day when you stood before the L-rd your G-d in Chorev, when the L-rd said to me:
Assemble the people unto Me, and I shall make them hear My words,

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִלְמְד֜וּן לְיִרְאָ֣ה אֹתִ֗י כׇּל־הַיָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וְאֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם יְלַמֵּדֽוּן׃
pairs.english: so that they learn to fear Me all the days that they live on the earth, and so that they teach their children.
And you drew near and you stood at the foot of the mountain,
and the mountain burned in fire until the heart of the heavens:
darkness, cloud, and mist.
And the L-rd spoke to you from the midst of the fire.
You heard the sounds of words,
but you did not see a likeness, only a sound.

pairs.hebrew: וַיַּגֵּ֨ד לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־בְּרִית֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה אֶתְכֶם֙ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֑ים
pairs.english: And He told you His covenant, which He commanded you to do, the ten commandments.
And He wrote them on two tablets of stone.

pairs.hebrew: וְאֹתִ֞י צִוָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְלַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֔ם חֻקִּ֖ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִ֑ים
pairs.english: And the L-rd commanded me at that time to teach you [the oral law], statutes and judgments,

pairs.hebrew: לַעֲשֹׂתְכֶ֣ם אֹתָ֔ם בָּאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
pairs.english: to do them in the land whither you are crossing to inherit it.
And you shall take great heed to your souls.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א רְאִיתֶם֙ כׇּל־תְּמוּנָ֔ה בְּי֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם בְּחֹרֵ֖ב מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵֽשׁ׃
pairs.english: For you did not see any likeness on the day that the L-rd spoke to you in Chorev from the midst of the fire.

pairs.hebrew: פֶּ֨ן־תַּשְׁחִת֔וּן וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם לָכֶ֛ם פֶּ֖סֶל תְּמוּנַ֣ת כׇּל־סָ֑מֶל
pairs.english: Lest you corrupt yourselves and make for yourselves a graven image of the likeness of any form,
the figure of male or female,
The figure of any beast that is on the earth,

pairs.hebrew: תַּבְנִית֙ כׇּל־צִפּ֣וֹר כָּנָ֔ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּף בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
pairs.english: the figure of any winged bird which flies in the heaven,
The figure of any thing that creeps on the ground,
the figure of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth.

pairs.hebrew: וּפֶן־תִּשָּׂ֨א עֵינֶ֜יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֗יְמָה וְֽ֠רָאִ֠יתָ אֶת־הַשֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ וְאֶת־הַיָּרֵ֜חַ וְאֶת־הַכּֽוֹכָבִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם
pairs.english: And lest you lift your eyes to the heavens [to gaze upon the luminaries and to stray after them], and you see the sun and the moon and the stars — all the host of heaven —
and you go astray and bow down to them and serve them,

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָלַ֜ק יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֹתָ֔ם לְכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כׇּל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
pairs.english: which the L-rd your G-d allotted to all the peoples under all of the heavens [to provide illumination for them].

pairs.hebrew: וְאֶתְכֶם֙ לָקַ֣ח יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיּוֹצִ֥א אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִכּ֥וּר הַבַּרְזֶ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם
pairs.english: And you did the L-rd take, and He brought you forth from the iron crucible, from Egypt,

pairs.hebrew: לִהְי֥וֹת ל֛וֹ לְעַ֥ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: to be to Him a people of inheritance as of this day.
And the L-rd was wroth with me because of your deeds,
and He swore that I would not cross the Jordan

pairs.hebrew: וּלְבִלְתִּי־בֹא֙ אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה׃
pairs.english: and that I would not come to the good land that the L-rd your G-d gives to you as an inheritance.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י מֵת֙ בָּאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את אֵינֶ֥נִּי עֹבֵ֖ר אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן
pairs.english: For I shall die in this land; I [i.e., even my bones] shall not cross the Jordan.

pairs.hebrew: וְאַתֶּם֙ עֹֽבְרִ֔ים וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֕ם אֶת־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
pairs.english: And you shall cross and inherit this good land.

pairs.hebrew: הִשָּׁמְר֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם פֶּֽן־תִּשְׁכְּחוּ֙ אֶת־בְּרִ֤ית יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת עִמָּכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: Take heed unto yourselves lest you forget the covenant of the L-rd your G-d that He made with you

pairs.hebrew: וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם לָכֶ֥ם פֶּ֙סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
pairs.english: and you make for yourselves a graven image of the likeness of any [thing] that the L-rd your G-d has commanded you [not to make].

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֚י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֵ֥שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה ה֑וּא
pairs.english: For the L-rd your G-d is a consuming fire,
a jealous G-d ["jealous" in vengeance to exact punishment of idolators].

pairs.hebrew: כִּֽי־תוֹלִ֤יד בָּנִים֙ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים וְנוֹשַׁנְתֶּ֖ם בָּאָ֑רֶץ
pairs.english: When you bear sons and sons of sons and grow old (venoshantem) in the land [(an intimation that they would be exiled at the end of 852 years (this being the gematria of "venoshantem"). But He exiled them two years before, so that they not be subject to "you will go utterly lost" (26)],
and you corrupt yourselves and you make a graven image of the likeness of any [thing],
and you do what is evil in the eyes of the L-rd your G-d to anger Him,
I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day [that I have warned you]

pairs.hebrew: כִּֽי־אָבֹ֣ד תֹּאבֵדוּן֮ מַהֵר֒ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ
pairs.english: that you will go utterly lost, quickly, from the land whither you are crossing the Jordan to inherit it.

pairs.hebrew: לֹֽא־תַאֲרִיכֻ֤ן יָמִים֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֥י הִשָּׁמֵ֖ד תִּשָּׁמֵדֽוּן׃
pairs.english: You will not prolong days upon it, for you will be utterly destroyed.
And the L-rd will scatter you among the peoples,

pairs.hebrew: וְנִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר בַּגּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְנַהֵ֧ג יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃
pairs.english: and you will remain few in number among the nations whither the L-rd will lead you.

pairs.hebrew: וַעֲבַדְתֶּם־שָׁ֣ם אֱלֹהִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם עֵ֣ץ וָאֶ֔בֶן
pairs.english: And you will serve gods there [(By serving their worshippers, it is as if you serve them)], the work of the hands of man, wood and stone,

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יִרְאוּן֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּן וְלֹ֥א יֹֽאכְל֖וּן וְלֹ֥א יְרִיחֻֽן׃
pairs.english: which do not see and do not hear and do not eat and do not smell.
And you will seek from there the L-rd your G-d, and you will find Him
if you seek Him with all your heart and with all your soul.

pairs.hebrew: בַּצַּ֣ר לְךָ֔ וּמְצָא֕וּךָ כֹּ֖ל הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה בְּאַחֲרִית֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים
pairs.english: In your affliction, when all these things come upon you, in the end of days,
then you shall return to the L-rd your G-d and you shall hearken to His voice.
For a G-d of mercy is the L-rd your G-d.
He will not let go of you and He will not destroy you,

pairs.hebrew: וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת־בְּרִ֣ית אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָהֶֽם׃
pairs.english: and He will not forget the covenant of your fathers, which He swore to them.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י שְׁאַל־נָא֩ לְיָמִ֨ים רִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־הָי֣וּ לְפָנֶ֗יךָ לְמִן־הַיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ אָדָם֙ עַל־הָאָ֔רֶץ
pairs.english: For ask, now, concerning the first days which were before you, from the day G-d created man upon the earth,
[and ask also of all the creations] from one end of the heavens to the other end:

pairs.hebrew: הֲנִֽהְיָ֗ה כַּדָּבָ֤ר הַגָּדוֹל֙ הַזֶּ֔ה א֖וֹ הֲנִשְׁמַ֥ע כָּמֹֽהוּ׃
pairs.english: Has there ever been the like of this great thing or has its like ever been heard?

pairs.hebrew: הֲשָׁ֣מַֽע עָם֩ ק֨וֹל אֱלֹהִ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ־הָאֵ֛שׁ
pairs.english: [the "great thing":] Has a people ever heard the voice of G-d speaking from the midst of the fire
as you have and lived?

pairs.hebrew: א֣וֹ ׀ הֲנִסָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֗ים לָ֠ב֠וֹא לָקַ֨חַת ל֣וֹ גוֹי֮ מִקֶּ֣רֶב גּוֹי֒
pairs.english: Or has a god ever done miracles to come and take for himself a nation from the midst of a nation

pairs.hebrew: בְּמַסֹּת֩ בְּאֹתֹ֨ת וּבְמוֹפְתִ֜ים וּבְמִלְחָמָ֗ה וּבְיָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּבִזְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּבְמוֹרָאִ֖ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים
pairs.english: with [self-imposed] trials, [by which He manifested His strength, e.g., (Exodus 8:5): "Presume to test me, etc." to see whether I can do so], with signs, [confirming Moses as G-d's messenger, e.g., (Ibid. 4:2): "What is this in your hand, etc."], and with wonders, [such as the "wondrous" plagues], and with war, [at the Red Sea, viz. (Ibid. 14:25): "For the L-rd wars for them"], and with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with great terrors,

pairs.hebrew: כְּ֠כֹ֠ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
pairs.english: as all that the L-rd your G-d did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

pairs.hebrew: אַתָּה֙ הׇרְאֵ֣תָ לָדַ֔עַת כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים
pairs.english: You have been shown to know that the L-rd, He is G-d;
there is none beside Him. [When the Holy One Blessed be He gave the Torah, He opened the seven heavens and the lower regions, and they saw that He was One].
From the heavens He made you hear His voice to exhort you,
and on the earth He showed you His great fire,
and His words you heard from the midst of the fire.

pairs.hebrew: וְתַ֗חַת כִּ֤י אָהַב֙ אֶת־אֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ וַיִּבְחַ֥ר בְּזַרְע֖וֹ אַחֲרָ֑יו
pairs.english: And [all this] because He loved your fathers and He chose their seed after them;
and He took you out before Him [as a father leads his son before him (see Exodus 14:19)] with His great strength from Egypt.

pairs.hebrew: לְהוֹרִ֗ישׁ גּוֹיִ֛ם גְּדֹלִ֧ים וַעֲצֻמִ֛ים מִמְּךָ֖ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ
pairs.english: To drive out before you nations greater and mightier than you,

pairs.hebrew: לַהֲבִֽיאֲךָ֗ לָֽתֶת־לְךָ֧ אֶת־אַרְצָ֛ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: to bring you, to give to you their land as an inheritance as [you see] this day.
And you shall know this day, and you shall set it to your heart,

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם מִמַּ֔עַל וְעַל־הָאָ֖רֶץ מִתָּ֑חַת
pairs.english: that the L-rd, He is G-d, in the heavens above and on the earth below;
there is none else.

pairs.hebrew: וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֞ אֶת־חֻקָּ֣יו וְאֶת־מִצְוֺתָ֗יו אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם
pairs.english: And you shall keep His statutes and His mitzvoth which I command you this day,
which will confer good upon you and your children after you,

pairs.hebrew: וּלְמַ֨עַן תַּאֲרִ֤יךְ יָמִים֙ עַל־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ כׇּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ {פ}
pairs.english: and so that you prolong days upon the land that the L-rd your G-d gives you all of the days.

Then Moses would set apart three cities [i.e., He resolved to set them apart (even though they would not serve as cities of refuge until those in the land of Canaan had been designated, Moses seizing upon the mitzvah that came to hand)],
across the Jordan towards the rising of the sun [i.e., on the east of the Jordan].

pairs.hebrew: לָנֻ֨ס שָׁ֜מָּה רוֹצֵ֗חַ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְצַ֤ח אֶת־רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ בִּבְלִי־דַ֔עַת וְה֛וּא לֹא־שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖וֹ מִתְּמֹ֣ל שִׁלְשֹׁ֑ם
pairs.english: To flee there a slayer who slays his neighbor unwittingly, not having hated him heretofore;
and he shall flee to one of these cities and he shall live.
Betzer in the desert in the land of the plain for the Reuveni,
Ramoth in Gilead for the Gileadi,
and Golan in Bashan for the Menashi.
And this [(that which follows)] is the Torah
which Moses placed before the children of Israel.
These [which follow] are the [same] testimonies and statutes and judgments

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
pairs.english: which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they went out of Egypt.

pairs.hebrew: בְּעֵ֨בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֜ן בַּגַּ֗יְא מ֚וּל בֵּ֣ית פְּע֔וֹר
pairs.english: [He repeated them in the plains of Moav] across the Jordan [on the east], in the valley, opposite Beth Peor,

pairs.hebrew: בְּאֶ֗רֶץ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן
pairs.english: in the land of Sichon king of the Emori, who dwelt in Cheshbon,

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה מֹשֶׁה֙ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
pairs.english: whom Moses and the children of Israel smote when they went out of Egypt.
And they inherited his land and the land of Og the king of Bashan,

pairs.hebrew: שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִזְרַ֖ח שָֽׁמֶשׁ׃
pairs.english: the two kings of the Emori, who were across the Jordan on the east.
From Aroer, which is by the bank of the stream of Arnon,
until Mount Sion, which is Chermon.
And the entire plain across the Jordan to the east

pairs.hebrew: וְעַ֖ד יָ֣ם הָעֲרָבָ֑ה תַּ֖חַת אַשְׁדֹּ֥ת הַפִּסְגָּֽה׃ {פ}
pairs.english: until the sea of the plain beneath Ashdoth Hapisgah.
And Moses called to all of Israel and he said to them:

pairs.hebrew: שְׁמַ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־הַחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י דֹּבֵ֥ר בְּאׇזְנֵיכֶ֖ם הַיּ֑וֹם
pairs.english: Hear, O Israel, the statutes and the judgments which I speak in your ears this day,
and learn and observe them to do them.
The L-rd our G-d made a covenant with us
in Chorev.

pairs.hebrew: לֹ֣א אֶת־אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ כָּרַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־הַבְּרִ֣ית הַזֹּ֑את
pairs.english: Not with our fathers [alone] did the L-rd make this covenant,

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י אִתָּ֔נוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ אֵ֥לֶּה פֹ֛ה הַיּ֖וֹם כֻּלָּ֥נוּ חַיִּֽים׃
pairs.english: but with us — we — these who are here today, all of us living.
Face to face [and not through an intermediary (whom you might accuse of dissimulation)] did the L-rd speak with you
in the mountain from the midst of the fire.

pairs.hebrew: אָ֠נֹכִ֠י עֹמֵ֨ד בֵּין־יְהֹוָ֤ה וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔וא לְהַגִּ֥יד לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה
pairs.english: I stood between the L-rd and you at that time to relate to you the word of the L-rd,

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֤י יְרֵאתֶם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ וְלֹֽא־עֲלִיתֶ֥ם בָּהָ֖ר לֵאמֹֽר׃ {ס}
pairs.english: for you were awed before the fire and you did not ascend the mountain. [(4): "…did the L-rd speak with you"], saying:
[see Exodus 20:1-14] I am the L-rd your G-d

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛יךָ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֣֥ית עֲבָדִ֑͏ֽים׃
pairs.english: who took you out of the land of Egypt from the house of bondage.
There shall not be unto you gods of others
before My presence [i.e., wherever I am — the entire world].
You shall not make for yourself a graven image or the likeness of anything which is in the heavens above

pairs.hebrew: וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר֩ בָּאָ֖֨רֶץ מִתָּ֑͏ַ֜חַת וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּמַּ֖֣יִם ׀ מִתַּ֥֣חַת לָאָֽ֗רֶץ׃
pairs.english: or in the earth below, or in the waters beneath the earth.
You shall not bow down to them and you shall not serve them,

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א
pairs.english: for I am the L-rd your G-d, a jealous G-d,

pairs.hebrew: פֹּ֠קֵ֠ד עֲוֺ֨ן אָב֧וֹת עַל־בָּנִ֛ים וְעַל־שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְעַל־רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְשֹׂנְאָֽ֑י׃
pairs.english: visiting the sins of the fathers upon the children, and for the third and the fourth generations to those who hate Me,
And doing lovingkindness for thousands,
for My lovers and the keepers of My mitzvoth.
You shall not take the name of the L-rd your G-d in vain,

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת־שְׁמ֖וֹ לַשָּֽׁוְא׃ {ס}
pairs.english: for the L-rd will not absolve him who takes His name in vain.
Keep the Sabbath day to set it apart ["Remember" (Exodus 20:8) and "Keep" were stated in one pronouncement, spoken in one word, and heard in one hearing)],
as the L-rd your G-d commanded you [before the giving of the Torah, in Marah].
Six days shall you work,
and you shall do all of your labor.
And the seventh day is Sabbath to the L-rd your G-d.

pairs.hebrew: לֹ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כׇל־מְלָאכָ֡ה אַתָּ֣ה וּבִנְךָֽ־וּבִתֶּ֣ךָ וְעַבְדְּךָֽ־וַ֠אֲמָתֶ֠ךָ וְשׁוֹרְךָ֨ וַחֲמֹֽרְךָ֜ וְכׇל־בְּהֶמְתֶּ֗ךָ וְגֵֽרְךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּשְׁעָרֶ֔יךָ
pairs.english: You shall not perform any labor: you, and your son, and your daughter, and your man-servant, and your maid-servant, and your ox, and your ass, and all of your beasts, and your sojourner in your gates,
so that your man-servant and your maid-servant rest like you.
And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt,

pairs.hebrew: וַיֹּצִ֨אֲךָ֜֩ יְהֹוָ֤֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֤֙יךָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם֙ בְּיָ֥֤ד חֲזָקָ֖ה֙ וּבִזְרֹ֣עַ נְטוּיָ֑֔ה
pairs.english: and that the L-rd your G-d took you out of there with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm [so that you would be His servants and keep His mitzvoth];

pairs.hebrew: עַל־כֵּ֗ן צִוְּךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת־י֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּֽת׃ {ס}
pairs.english: therefore, the L-rd your G-d commanded you to observe the Sabbath day.

pairs.hebrew: כַּבֵּ֤ד אֶת־אָבִ֙יךָ֙ וְאֶת־אִמֶּ֔ךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ
pairs.english: Honor your father and your mother, as the L-rd your G-d commanded you [in Marah (see Exodus 15:25)],

pairs.hebrew: לְמַ֣עַן ׀ יַאֲרִיכֻ֣ן יָמֶ֗יךָ וּלְמַ֙עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽךְ׃ {ס}
pairs.english: so that your days be prolonged and so that it be good for you on the land which the L-rd your G-d gives to you.
You shall not kill.
And you shall not commit adultery.
And you shall not steal.
And you shall not testify against your neighbor false testimony.
And you shall not covet your neighbor's wife.
And you shall not desire your neighbor's house, his field,

pairs.hebrew: וְעַבְדּ֤וֹ וַאֲמָתוֹ֙ שׁוֹר֣וֹ וַחֲמֹר֔וֹ וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְרֵעֶֽךָ׃ {ס}
pairs.english: and his man-servant, and his maid-servant, his ox, and his ass, and all that belongs to your neighbor.

pairs.hebrew: אֶֽת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֡לֶּה דִּבֶּר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֶל־כׇּל־קְהַלְכֶ֜ם בָּהָ֗ר מִתּ֤וֹךְ הָאֵשׁ֙ הֶֽעָנָ֣ן וְהָֽעֲרָפֶ֔ל
pairs.english: These things the L-rd spoke to all of your congregation on the mountain from the midst of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness —
a great voice, and it did not cease, [His voice being strong and everlasting].

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיִּכְתְּבֵ֗ם עַל־שְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת אֲבָנִ֔ים וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
pairs.english: And He wrote them on two tablets of stone and He gave them to me.

pairs.hebrew: וַיְהִ֗י כְּשׇׁמְעֲכֶ֤ם אֶת־הַקּוֹל֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ
pairs.english: And it was, when you heard the voice from the midst of the darkness, and the mountain burning in fire,
that you drew near to me, all the heads of your tribes and your elders.

pairs.hebrew: וַתֹּאמְר֗וּ הֵ֣ן הֶרְאָ֜נוּ יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ אֶת־כְּבֹד֣וֹ וְאֶת־גׇּדְל֔וֹ
pairs.english: And you said: Behold, the L-rd our G-d has shown us His glory and His greatness,
and we heard His voice from the midst of the fire.

pairs.hebrew: הַיּ֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ רָאִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי־יְדַבֵּ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָֽאָדָ֖ם וָחָֽי׃
pairs.english: This day we saw that G-d may speak with a man and he live!

pairs.hebrew: וְעַתָּה֙ לָ֣מָּה נָמ֔וּת כִּ֣י תֹֽאכְלֵ֔נוּ הָאֵ֥שׁ הַגְּדֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את
pairs.english: And now, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us.

pairs.hebrew: אִם־יֹסְפִ֣ים ׀ אֲנַ֗חְנוּ לִ֠שְׁמֹ֠עַ אֶת־ק֨וֹל יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ ע֖וֹד וָמָֽתְנוּ׃
pairs.english: If we continue hearing the voice of the L-rd our G-d we shall die.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י מִ֣י כׇל־בָּשָׂ֡ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע קוֹל֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים חַיִּ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִתּוֹךְ־הָאֵ֛שׁ
pairs.english: For who is there of all flesh who heard the voice of the living G-d speaking from the midst of the fire,
as we have, and lived?

pairs.hebrew: קְרַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ וּֽשְׁמָ֔ע אֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ
pairs.english: You draw near and hear all that the L-rd our G-d says,

pairs.hebrew: וְאַ֣תְּ ׀ תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֗ינוּ אֵת֩ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְדַבֵּ֜ר יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ
pairs.english: and you ["at," the feminine form (Moses saying: You rendered me weak (as a woman) by saying this. Were it not better to draw near to Him in love and hear it from Him rather than from me!)], speak to us all that the L-rd our G-d will speak to you,
and we shall hear and we shall do.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶ֔ם בְּדַבֶּרְכֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑י וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י
pairs.english: And the L-rd heard the voice of your words in speaking to me. And the L-rd said to me:

pairs.hebrew: שָׁ֠מַ֠עְתִּי אֶת־ק֨וֹל דִּבְרֵ֜י הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבְּר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ
pairs.english: I have heard the voice of the words of this people that they spoke to you.
They have done well in all that they have spoken.

pairs.hebrew: מִֽי־יִתֵּ֡ן וְהָיָה֩ לְבָבָ֨ם זֶ֜ה לָהֶ֗ם לְיִרְאָ֥ה אֹתִ֛י וְלִשְׁמֹ֥ר אֶת־כׇּל־מִצְוֺתַ֖י כׇּל־הַיָּמִ֑ים
pairs.english: Would that this heart of theirs were in them to fear Me and to keep all of My mitzvoth all of the days
so that it be good for them and for their children forever!
Go, say to them:
Return you to your tents.
And you, stand here with Me,

pairs.hebrew: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ אֵ֧ת כׇּל־הַמִּצְוָ֛ה וְהַחֻקִּ֥ים וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּלַמְּדֵ֑ם
pairs.english: and I shall speak to you all the mitzvah and the statutes and the judgments that you shall teach them

pairs.hebrew: וְעָשׂ֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָהֶ֖ם לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
pairs.english: and that they shall do in the land that I give them to inherit.

pairs.hebrew: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם אֶתְכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: And you shall observe to do as the L-rd your G-d commanded you;
you shall not turn right or left.

pairs.hebrew: בְּכׇל־הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֛ם אֶתְכֶ֖ם תֵּלֵ֑כוּ
pairs.english: In all the way that the L-rd your G-d commanded you shall you go,

pairs.hebrew: לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיוּן֙ וְט֣וֹב לָכֶ֔ם וְהַאֲרַכְתֶּ֣ם יָמִ֔ים בָּאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּֽירָשֽׁוּן׃
pairs.english: so that you live and it be good for you, and you prolong days in the land that you shall inherit.

pairs.hebrew: וְזֹ֣את הַמִּצְוָ֗ה הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם לְלַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: And this is the mitzvah, the statutes and the judgments that the L‑rd your G‑d commanded to teach you

pairs.hebrew: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃
pairs.english: to do in the land whither you are crossing over to inherit it —

pairs.hebrew: לְמַ֨עַן תִּירָ֜א אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ לִ֠שְׁמֹ֠ר אֶת־כׇּל־חֻקֹּתָ֣יו וּמִצְוֺתָיו֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוֶּ֒ךָ֒
pairs.english: So that you fear the L‑rd your G‑d to keep all of His statutes and His mitzvoth that I command you —

pairs.hebrew: אַתָּה֙ וּבִנְךָ֣ וּבֶן־בִּנְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ
pairs.english: you, and your son, and your son's son, all the days of your life,
and so that your days are prolonged.
And you shall hear, Israel, and you shall observe to do,

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְךָ֔ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְבּ֖וּן מְאֹ֑ד
pairs.english: so that it be good for you and so that you increase greatly,

pairs.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃ {פ}
pairs.english: as the L‑rd, the G‑d of your fathers, spoke to you — ("to inherit it":) a land flowing milk and honey.
Hear, O Israel,
the L‑rd [who is] our G‑d [now, and not the G‑d of the peoples — He is destined to be] the one L‑rd.
And you shall love the L‑rd your G‑d [(Do His mitzvoth out of love)],
with all your heart [(with both of your inclinations)]
and with all your soul [(even if He takes your soul)] and with all your might [(with all your wealth — this, for one whose wealth is more beloved of him than his soul)].

pairs.hebrew: וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם
pairs.english: ["And you shall love, etc." What is this love?] And these things that I command you this day [(They should be like a "new edict" to you)]
shall be upon your heart [(for you thereby come to know the Holy One Blessed be He and to cleave to His ways)].

And you shall teach them (veshinantam) to your sons [lit., "and they (words of Torah) shall be sharp" (in your mouth), so that if one questions you concerning them you will not stammer but answer him forthwith ("sons" here are disciples, and teachers are called "fathers")].
And you shall speak [primarily] in them [words of Torah] in your sitting in your house and in your walking upon the way
and in your lying down [i.e., the time of lying down] and in your rising [i.e., the time of rising].
And you shall bind them as a sign upon your hand [(the arm phylactery)],
and they shall be frontlets (totafoth) [denoting "four" (Scriptural sections)] between your eyes [(the head phylactery)].

And you shall write them on the doorposts (mezuzoth) of your house ["mezuzoth" is written defective (without the vav after the first zayin), indicating that only one mezuzah (per doorpost) is needed],
and on your gates [(including the gates of courtyards, provinces, and cities)].

pairs.hebrew: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּ֥י יְבִיאֲךָ֣ ׀ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֶל־הָאָ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֛ם לְיִצְחָ֥ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לָ֣תֶת לָ֑ךְ
pairs.english: And it shall be, when the L‑rd your G‑d brings you to the land that He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to you,
great and good cities that you did not build,

pairs.hebrew: וּבָ֨תִּ֜ים מְלֵאִ֣ים כׇּל־טוּב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־מִלֵּ֒אתָ֒ וּבֹרֹ֤ת חֲצוּבִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־חָצַ֔בְתָּ
pairs.english: And houses full of all good that you did not fill, hewn cisterns [(the ground being rocky)], which you did not hew,
and vineyards and olive groves, which you did not plant,
and you shall eat and be sated —
Take heed unto yourselves lest you forget the L‑rd,

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצִֽיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃
pairs.english: who took you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
The L‑rd your G‑d shall you fear, and Him shall you serve,
and [only then (if you fear and serve Him)] in His name may you swear [(for you will then be circumspect in your oath; but otherwise, do not swear in His name)].
Do not follow after other gods,
of the gods of the peoples that are around you [i.e., Be especially heedful of the latter in that their proximity presents an immediate danger.]

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י אֵ֥ל קַנָּ֛א יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ
pairs.english: For a jealous G‑d is the L‑rd your G‑d in your midst.

pairs.hebrew: פֶּן־יֶ֠חֱרֶ֠ה אַף־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְהִשְׁמִ֣ידְךָ֔ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ {ס}
pairs.english: Lest the wrath of the L‑rd your G‑d burn against you, and He destroy you from off the face of the ground.
Do not try the L‑rd your G‑d
as you tried Him in Massah [when they went out of Egypt and they tried Him with water (Exodus 17:7)].
Heed diligently the mitzvoth of the L‑rd your G‑d,
and His testimonies and statutes which He commanded you.
And you shall do what is just and what is good in the eyes of the L‑rd [i.e., compromise, beyond the strict letter of the law],
so that He do good to you,

pairs.hebrew: וּבָ֗אתָ וְיָֽרַשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהֹוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
pairs.english: and you come and inherit the good land that the L‑rd swore to your forefathers.
To thrust out all of your foes before you,
as the L‑rd spoke [(Exodus 23:27): "And I shall confound all the people, etc."]
If your son ask you in time to come, saying:

pairs.hebrew: מָ֣ה הָעֵדֹ֗ת וְהַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֶתְכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: What are the testimonies and the statutes and the judgments which the L‑rd our G‑d commanded you?

pairs.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לְבִנְךָ֔ עֲבָדִ֛ים הָיִ֥ינוּ לְפַרְעֹ֖ה בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם
pairs.english: Then you shall say to your son: We were slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt,
and the L‑rd took us out of Egypt with a strong hand.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן יְהֹוָ֡ה אוֹתֹ֣ת וּ֠מֹפְתִ֠ים גְּדֹלִ֨ים וְרָעִ֧ים ׀ בְּמִצְרַ֛יִם
pairs.english: And the L‑rd wrought signs and wonders, great and sore, against Egypt,
against Pharaoh, and against his whole household, before our eyes.
And he took us thence

pairs.hebrew: לְמַ֙עַן֙ הָבִ֣יא אֹתָ֔נוּ לָ֤תֶת לָ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
pairs.english: in order to bring us to give to us the land that He swore to our fathers.

pairs.hebrew: וַיְצַוֵּ֣נוּ יְהֹוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַחֻקִּ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְיִרְאָ֖ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ
pairs.english: And the L‑rd commanded us to do all of these statutes to fear the L‑rd our G‑d

pairs.hebrew: לְט֥וֹב לָ֙נוּ֙ כׇּל־הַיָּמִ֔ים לְחַיֹּתֵ֖נוּ כְּהַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: so that it be good for us all of the days, to keep us in life, as this day.
And it shall be [accounted] righteousness to us

pairs.hebrew: כִּֽי־נִשְׁמֹ֨ר לַעֲשׂ֜וֹת אֶת־כׇּל־הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֗את לִפְנֵ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽנוּ׃ {ס}
pairs.english: if we observe to do all of this mitzvah before the L‑rd our G‑d as He commanded us.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֤י יְבִֽיאֲךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶל־הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה בָא־שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ
pairs.english: When the L-rd your G-d brings you to the land whither you come to inherit it,

pairs.hebrew: וְנָשַׁ֣ל גּֽוֹיִם־רַבִּ֣ים ׀ מִפָּנֶ֡יךָ הַֽחִתִּי֩ וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֨י וְהָאֱמֹרִ֜י וְהַכְּנַעֲנִ֣י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֗י וְהַֽחִוִּי֙ וְהַיְבוּסִ֔י
pairs.english: and He casts out many nations before you: the Chitti, the Girgashi, the Emori, the Canaani, the Perizi, the Chivi, and the Yevussi —
seven nations more numerous and mightier than you.

pairs.hebrew: וּנְתָנָ֞ם יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ וְהִכִּיתָ֑ם הַחֲרֵ֤ם תַּחֲרִים֙ אֹתָ֔ם
pairs.english: And the L-rd your G-d delivers them before you and you smite them — lay them waste.
You shall not make a covenant with them and you shall not grant them grace [(It is forbidden to say: "How beautiful is this heathen!")].
And you shall not intermarry with them:

pairs.hebrew: בִּתְּךָ֙ לֹא־תִתֵּ֣ן לִבְנ֔וֹ וּבִתּ֖וֹ לֹא־תִקַּ֥ח לִבְנֶֽךָ׃
pairs.english: Your daughter you shall not give to his son, and his daughter you shall not take for your son.

pairs.hebrew: כִּֽי־יָסִ֤יר אֶת־בִּנְךָ֙ מֵֽאַחֲרַ֔י וְעָבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים
pairs.english: For he [your heathen son-in-law] will turn your son [i.e., your grandson] away from Me, [(whence it is seen that your daughter's son by a gentile is called your son (but not your son's son born to a gentile woman, it not being written "For she will turn, etc.")], and they will serve other gods,
and the wrath of the L-rd will burn in you, and He will destroy you quickly.
But thus shall you do to them:
Their [built-up] altars shall you destroy, and their monuments [of one stone] shall you break,
and their asheirah trees, [which they worship] shall you cut down, and their graven images shall you burn with fire.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ
pairs.english: For a holy nation are you to the L-rd your G-d.

pairs.hebrew: בְּךָ֞ בָּחַ֣ר ׀ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ לִהְי֥וֹת לוֹ֙ לְעַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה
pairs.english: In you has the L-rd your G-d chosen to be unto Him a select people
of all the peoples on the face of the earth.

pairs.hebrew: לֹ֣א מֵֽרֻבְּכֶ֞ם מִכׇּל־הָֽעַמִּ֗ים חָשַׁ֧ק יְהֹוָ֛ה בָּכֶ֖ם וַיִּבְחַ֣ר בָּכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: Not because you are more numerous than all the peoples did the L-rd desire you and choose you,
for you are the smallest of all the peoples.

pairs.hebrew: כִּי֩ מֵאַהֲבַ֨ת יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶתְכֶ֗ם וּמִשׇּׁמְר֤וֹ אֶת־הַשְּׁבֻעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּע֙ לַאֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם
pairs.english: But out of the L-rd's love for you and in keeping with His oath that He swore to your fathers
did the L-rd take you out with a strong hand,

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיִּפְדְּךָ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים מִיַּ֖ד פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ־מִצְרָֽיִם׃
pairs.english: and He redeemed you from the house of bondage, from the hand of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.

pairs.hebrew: וְיָ֣דַעְתָּ֔ כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ ה֣וּא הָֽאֱלֹהִ֑ים הָאֵל֙ הַֽנֶּאֱמָ֔ן
pairs.english: And you shall know that the L-rd your G-d is the god, the faithful G-d,

pairs.hebrew: שֹׁמֵ֧ר הַבְּרִ֣ית וְהַחֶ֗סֶד לְאֹהֲבָ֛יו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵ֥י מִצְוֺתָ֖ו לְאֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר׃
pairs.english: guarding the covenant and the lovingkindness for His lovers [those who do the mitzvoth out of love], and for the keepers of His mitzvoth [out of fear] for a thousand generations, [(but for "His lovers," for "thousands" (5:10)].
And He pays His haters to his face [He pays him the recompense for his good, in his lifetime] to make him go lost [from the world to come].
He shall not delay to [pay] His hater; to his face shall He pay him.
And you shall keep the mitzvah and the statutes and the judgments
which I command you today to do them; [and, tomorrow, in the world to come, you will receive their reward.]

pairs.hebrew: וְהָיָ֣ה ׀ עֵ֣קֶב תִּשְׁמְע֗וּן אֵ֤ת הַמִּשְׁפָּטִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם
pairs.english: And it shall be, if (ekev) you hearken to these judgments, and heed them and do them [i.e., if you observe the relatively slight mitzvoth, which men are wont to tread under their heel (ekev)],

pairs.hebrew: וְשָׁמַר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לְךָ֗ אֶֽת־הַבְּרִית֙ וְאֶת־הַחֶ֔סֶד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
pairs.english: then the L-rd your G-d will keep for you [His oath re] the covenant and the lovingkindness which He swore to your fathers.
And He will love you and bless you and multiply you,

pairs.hebrew: וּבֵרַ֣ךְ פְּרִֽי־בִטְנְךָ֣ וּפְרִֽי־אַ֠דְמָתֶ֠ךָ דְּגָ֨נְךָ֜ וְתִירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֗ךָ שְׁגַר־אֲלָפֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֔ךָ
pairs.english: and He will bless the fruit of your belly and the fruit of your earth: your corn and your wine and your oil, your kine sprung [from the womb] and your choice ones of the flock

pairs.hebrew: עַ֚ל הָֽאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָ֥תֶת לָֽךְ׃
pairs.english: on the earth which He swore to your fathers to give to you.
Blessed shall you be of all the peoples.
There shall not be among you a barren male or female, or among your beasts.
And the L-rd shall remove from you every ill.

pairs.hebrew: וְכׇל־מַדְוֵי֩ מִצְרַ֨יִם הָרָעִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדַ֗עְתָּ לֹ֤א יְשִׂימָם֙ בָּ֔ךְ
pairs.english: And all the sore travails of Egypt which you knew, He shall not place in you,
but He shall place them in all of your haters.

pairs.hebrew: וְאָכַלְתָּ֣ אֶת־כׇּל־הָֽעַמִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֔ךְ
pairs.english: And you shall devour all the peoples that the L-rd your G-d delivers unto you.
Let your eye have no mercy upon them
and do not serve their gods; for it is a snare unto you.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֤י תֹאמַר֙ בִּלְבָ֣בְךָ֔ רַבִּ֛ים הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֖לֶּה מִמֶּ֑נִּי
pairs.english: Lest you say in your heart: (Many) more are these nations than I —
How will I be able to drive them out!
— You shall not fear them.

pairs.hebrew: זָכֹ֣ר תִּזְכֹּ֗ר אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לְפַרְעֹ֖ה וּלְכׇל־מִצְרָֽיִם׃
pairs.english: Remember well what the L-rd your G-d did to Pharaoh and to all of Egypt.

pairs.hebrew: הַמַּסֹּ֨ת הַגְּדֹלֹ֜ת אֲשֶׁר־רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וְהָאֹתֹ֤ת וְהַמֹּֽפְתִים֙ וְהַיָּ֤ד הַחֲזָקָה֙ וְהַזְּרֹ֣עַ הַנְּטוּיָ֔ה
pairs.english: The great trials that your eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders (see 4:34), and the strong hand [the (plague of) pestilence], and the outstretched arm [the "sword" of the plague of the first-born]
wherewith the L-rd your G-d took you out.

pairs.hebrew: כֵּֽן־יַעֲשֶׂ֞ה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ לְכׇל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה יָרֵ֖א מִפְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
pairs.english: Thus shall the L-rd your G-d do to all of the peoples whom you fear.

pairs.hebrew: וְגַם֙ אֶת־הַצִּרְעָ֔ה יְשַׁלַּ֛ח יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בָּ֑ם
pairs.english: And also the tzirah [a kind of flying insect, which poisoned them, and castrated them, and blinded their eyes wherever they were hiding] will the L-rd your G-d send against them,
until there shall perish the remnant and the hidden from before you.
Do not break before them,

pairs.hebrew: כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בְּקִרְבֶּ֔ךָ אֵ֥ל גָּד֖וֹל וְנוֹרָֽא׃
pairs.english: for the L-rd your G-d is in your midst, a great and awesome G-d.

pairs.hebrew: וְנָשַׁל֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָאֵ֛ל מִפָּנֶ֖יךָ מְעַ֣ט מְעָ֑ט
pairs.english: And the L-rd your G-d will cast out these nations before you little by little.

pairs.hebrew: לֹ֤א תוּכַל֙ כַּלֹּתָ֣ם מַהֵ֔ר פֶּן־תִּרְבֶּ֥ה עָלֶ֖יךָ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
pairs.english: You will not be able to consume them quickly, lest there increase against you the animals of the field.
And the L-rd your G-d shall deliver them before you.
And He shall confound them with a great confusion until they are destroyed.

pairs.hebrew: וְנָתַ֤ן מַלְכֵיהֶם֙ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת־שְׁמָ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם
pairs.english: And He will deliver their kings into your hand, and you shall cause their name to go lost from under the heavens.

pairs.hebrew: לֹֽא־יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִישׁ֙ בְּפָנֶ֔יךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִֽדְךָ֖ אֹתָֽם׃
pairs.english: A man will not stand up against you until you have destroyed them.
The graven images of their gods shall you burn in fire.

pairs.hebrew: לֹֽא־תַחְמֹד֩ כֶּ֨סֶף וְזָהָ֤ב עֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ לָ֔ךְ פֶּ֚ן תִּוָּקֵ֣שׁ בּ֔וֹ
pairs.english: You shall not covet the silver and the gold upon them and take it to you lest you be ensnared by it.
For it is the abomination of the L-rd your G-d.

pairs.hebrew: וְלֹא־תָבִ֤יא תֽוֹעֵבָה֙ אֶל־בֵּיתֶ֔ךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ חֵ֖רֶם כָּמֹ֑הוּ
pairs.english: And you shall not bring an abomination into your house, lest you be rejected as it is.
Despise shall you despise it and abominate shall you abominate it; for it is rejected.

pairs.hebrew: כׇּל־הַמִּצְוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם תִּשְׁמְר֣וּן לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת
pairs.english: Every mitzvah which I command to you this day shall you observe to do,

pairs.hebrew: לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּן וּרְבִיתֶ֗ם וּבָאתֶם֙ וִֽירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהֹוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: that you may live and multiply, and come and inherit the land that the L-rd your G-d swore to your fathers.

pairs.hebrew: וְזָכַרְתָּ֣ אֶת־כׇּל־הַדֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹלִֽיכְךָ֜ יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ זֶ֛ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר
pairs.english: And you shall remember all the way in which the L-rd your G-d led you this forty years in the desert,
to afflict you to test you

pairs.hebrew: לָדַ֜עַת אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֧ר בִּֽלְבָבְךָ֛ הֲתִשְׁמֹ֥ר מִצְוֺתָ֖ו אִם־לֹֽא׃
pairs.english: to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep His mitzvoth [without trying Him or "bethinking yourself" of Him], or not.

pairs.hebrew: וַֽיְעַנְּךָ֮ וַיַּרְעִבֶ֒ךָ֒ וַיַּאֲכִֽלְךָ֤ אֶת־הַמָּן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יָדַ֔עְתָּ וְלֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ
pairs.english: And He afflicted you, and He made you hunger, and He fed you the manna, which you did not know, and which your fathers did not know,

pairs.hebrew: לְמַ֣עַן הוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל־הַלֶּ֤חֶם לְבַדּוֹ֙ יִחְיֶ֣ה הָֽאָדָ֔ם
pairs.english: to make it known to you that not through bread alone shall a man live,
but by all that issues from the mouth of the L-rd shall a man live.
Your raiment did not wear out from upon you [The clouds of glory would rub their clothing clean, and the garments of children would grow to match their growth],

pairs.hebrew: וְרַגְלְךָ֖ לֹ֣א בָצֵ֑קָה זֶ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
pairs.english: and your feet did not swell [like dough (as occurs with those who go barefoot)] this forty years.

pairs.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ עִם־לְבָבֶ֑ךָ כִּ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יְיַסֵּ֥ר אִישׁ֙ אֶת־בְּנ֔וֹ
pairs.english: And you shall know within your heart that as a man afflicts his son,
so does the L-rd your G-d afflict you.
And you shall keep the mitzvoth of the L-rd your G-d,
to walk in His ways and fear Him.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֚י יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מְבִֽיאֲךָ֖ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ טוֹבָ֑ה
pairs.english: For the L-rd your G-d is bringing you to a good land,

pairs.hebrew: אֶ֚רֶץ נַ֣חֲלֵי מָ֔יִם עֲיָנֹת֙ וּתְהֹמֹ֔ת יֹצְאִ֥ים בַּבִּקְעָ֖ה וּבָהָֽר׃
pairs.english: a land of streams of water, fountains and depths, issuing forth in valleys and in mountains.

pairs.hebrew: אֶ֤רֶץ חִטָּה֙ וּשְׂעֹרָ֔ה וְגֶ֥פֶן וּתְאֵנָ֖ה וְרִמּ֑וֹן
pairs.english: A land of wheat, barley, grapevine, fig, and pomegranate;
a land of olive-oil and honey.

pairs.hebrew: אֶ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹ֤א בְמִסְכֵּנֻת֙ תֹּֽאכַל־בָּ֣הּ לֶ֔חֶם לֹֽא־תֶחְסַ֥ר כֹּ֖ל בָּ֑הּ
pairs.english: A land where not in constraint shall you eat bread. You shall lack nothing in it;

pairs.hebrew: אֶ֚רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲבָנֶ֣יהָ בַרְזֶ֔ל וּמֵהֲרָרֶ֖יהָ תַּחְצֹ֥ב נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
pairs.english: a land whose stones are iron and from whose mountains you shall hew copper.
And you shall eat, and you shall be sated,

pairs.hebrew: וּבֵֽרַכְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ עַל־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־לָֽךְ׃
pairs.english: and you shall bless the L-rd your G-d for the good land that He has given you.
Take heed unto yourself lest you forget the L-rd your G-d,

pairs.hebrew: לְבִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָיו֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו וְחֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃
pairs.english: not to keep His mitzvoth and His judgments and His statutes that I command you this day.
Lest you eat and be sated,
and you build and inhabit good houses,
And your herds and your flocks increase,

pairs.hebrew: וְכֶ֥סֶף וְזָהָ֖ב יִרְבֶּה־לָּ֑ךְ וְכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־לְךָ֖ יִרְבֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: and silver and gold increase for you, and whatever you have increase,
And your heart be lifted

pairs.hebrew: וְשָֽׁכַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַמּוֹצִיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃
pairs.english: and you forget the L-rd your G-d who took you out of the land of Egypt from the house of bondage,

pairs.hebrew: הַמּוֹלִ֨יכְךָ֜ בַּמִּדְבָּ֣ר ׀ הַגָּדֹ֣ל וְהַנּוֹרָ֗א נָחָ֤שׁ ׀ שָׂרָף֙ וְעַקְרָ֔ב וְצִמָּא֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין־מָ֑יִם
pairs.english: Who led you in the great, awesome desert of snake, serpent, scorpion and waterless drought,
who brought forth water for you from the rock of flint,

pairs.hebrew: הַמַּאֲכִ֨לְךָ֥ מָן֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יָדְע֖וּן אֲבֹתֶ֑יךָ
pairs.english: Who fed you manna in the desert, which your fathers did not know,

pairs.hebrew: לְמַ֣עַן עַנֹּֽתְךָ֗ וּלְמַ֙עַן֙ נַסֹּתֶ֔ךָ לְהֵיטִֽבְךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִיתֶֽךָ׃
pairs.english: in order to afflict you and in order to try you, to benefit you in your latter end,
And you say in your heart:

pairs.hebrew: כֹּחִי֙ וְעֹ֣צֶם יָדִ֔י עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖י אֶת־הַחַ֥יִל הַזֶּֽה׃
pairs.english: My strength and the might of my hand have wrought this wealth for me —
Then you shall remember the L-rd your G-d.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י ה֗וּא הַנֹּתֵ֥ן לְךָ֛ כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת חָ֑יִל
pairs.english: For it is He who gives you strength to prosper,

pairs.hebrew: לְמַ֨עַן הָקִ֧ים אֶת־בְּרִית֛וֹ אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃ {פ}
pairs.english: to establish His covenant that He swore to your fathers, as of this day.

pairs.hebrew: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־שָׁכֹ֤חַ תִּשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ וְהָֽלַכְתָּ֗ אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַעֲבַדְתָּ֖ם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֣יתָ לָהֶ֑ם
pairs.english: And it shall be, if you forget the L-rd your G-d and walk after other gods and serve them and bow down to them,

pairs.hebrew: הַעִדֹ֤תִי בָכֶם֙ הַיּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵדֽוּן׃
pairs.english: I testify against you this day that you shall surely go lost.

pairs.hebrew: כַּגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ מַאֲבִ֣יד מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם כֵּ֖ן תֹּאבֵד֑וּן
pairs.english: As the nations which the L-rd causes to go lost from before you, so will you go lost,

pairs.hebrew: עֵ֚קֶב לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֔וּן בְּק֖וֹל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
pairs.english: for you did not hearken to the voice of the L-rd your G-d.

pairs.hebrew: שְׁמַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֤ר הַיּוֹם֙ אֶת־הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן
pairs.english: Hear, O Israel, you are crossing over the Jordan today

pairs.hebrew: לָבֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת גּוֹיִ֔ם גְּדֹלִ֥ים וַעֲצֻמִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑ךָּ
pairs.english: to come to inherit nations who are greater and mightier than you [(You are mighty, but they are mightier than you)],
great cities, and fortified in the heavens.
A people great and lofty, the sons of Anakim,

pairs.hebrew: אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֙עְתָּ֙ וְאַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ מִ֣י יִתְיַצֵּ֔ב לִפְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָֽק׃
pairs.english: whom you know, and of whom you have heard (saying): Who can stand up against the sons of Anak!

pairs.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ֣ הַיּ֗וֹם כִּי֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ הֽוּא־הָעֹבֵ֤ר לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֵ֣שׁ אֹֽכְלָ֔ה
pairs.english: And you shall know this day that the L-rd your G-d — He crosses over before you, a consuming fire.
He shall destroy them and He shall humble them before you.

pairs.hebrew: וְהֽוֹרַשְׁתָּ֤ם וְהַֽאֲבַדְתָּם֙ מַהֵ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה לָֽךְ׃
pairs.english: And you shall drive them out, and you shall cause them to go lost quickly, as the L-rd has spoken to you.

pairs.hebrew: אַל־תֹּאמַ֣ר בִּלְבָבְךָ֗ בַּהֲדֹ֣ף יְהֹוָה֩ אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ אֹתָ֥ם ׀ מִלְּפָנֶ֘יךָ֮ לֵאמֹר֒
pairs.english: Do not say in your heart, when the L-rd your G-d thrusts them from before you:

pairs.hebrew: בְּצִדְקָתִי֙ הֱבִיאַ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֔ה לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את
pairs.english: In my righteousness did the L-rd bring me to inherit this land,

pairs.hebrew: וּבְרִשְׁעַת֙ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה יְהֹוָ֖ה מוֹרִישָׁ֥ם מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
pairs.english: and that because of the wickedness of these nations [together with your righteousness] the L-rd drives them out before you.

pairs.hebrew: לֹ֣א בְצִדְקָתְךָ֗ וּבְיֹ֙שֶׁר֙ לְבָ֣בְךָ֔ אַתָּ֥ה בָ֖א לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־אַרְצָ֑ם
pairs.english: Not in your righteousness and in the uprightness of your heart do you come to inherit their land,

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֞י בְּרִשְׁעַ֣ת ׀ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֗לֶּה יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ מוֹרִישָׁ֣ם מִפָּנֶ֔יךָ
pairs.english: but in the wickedness of these nations does the L-rd your G-d drive them out before you,

pairs.hebrew: וּלְמַ֜עַן הָקִ֣ים אֶת־הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ לַאֲבֹתֶ֔יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֥ם לְיִצְחָ֖ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹֽב׃
pairs.english: and to establish the thing that the L-rd swore to your fathers: to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

pairs.hebrew: וְיָדַעְתָּ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֤א בְצִדְקָֽתְךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱ֠לֹהֶ֠יךָ נֹתֵ֨ן לְךָ֜ אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֛ה הַזֹּ֖את לְרִשְׁתָּ֑הּ
pairs.english: And you shall know that it is not in your righteousness that the L-rd your G-d gives you this good land to inherit it,
for you are a stiff-necked people.

pairs.hebrew: זְכֹר֙ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֔ח אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר־הִקְצַ֛פְתָּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר
pairs.english: Remember, do not forget, your having angered the L-rd your G-d in the desert.

pairs.hebrew: לְמִן־הַיּ֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יָצָ֣אתָ ׀ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם עַד־בֹּֽאֲכֶם֙ עַד־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה מַמְרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם עִם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
pairs.english: From the day you left the land of Egypt until your coming to this place, you have been rebellious against the L-rd.
And in Chorev you angered the L-rd,
and the L-rd was wroth with you to destroy you.

pairs.hebrew: בַּעֲלֹתִ֣י הָהָ֗רָה לָקַ֜חַת לוּחֹ֤ת הָֽאֲבָנִים֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הַבְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר־כָּרַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה עִמָּכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: When I went up to the mountain to take the tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant that the L-rd made with you.

pairs.hebrew: וָאֵשֵׁ֣ב בָּהָ֗ר אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה
pairs.english: And I was kept in the mountain forty days and forty nights.

pairs.hebrew: לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔לְתִּי וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֥א שָׁתִֽיתִי׃
pairs.english: Bread I did not eat, and water I did not drink.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֶת־שְׁנֵי֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הָֽאֲבָנִ֔ים כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּאֶצְבַּ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים
pairs.english: And the L-rd gave me the two tablets of stone, [(both were alike)], written with the finger of G-d;

pairs.hebrew: וַעֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כְּֽכׇל־הַדְּבָרִ֡ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה עִמָּכֶ֥ם בָּהָ֛ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵ֖שׁ בְּי֥וֹם הַקָּהָֽל׃
pairs.english: and on them as all the things that the L-rd spoke with you in the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly.

pairs.hebrew: וַיְהִ֗י מִקֵּץ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה
pairs.english: And it was at the end of forty days and forty nights

pairs.hebrew: נָתַ֨ן יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֶת־שְׁנֵ֛י לֻחֹ֥ת הָאֲבָנִ֖ים לֻח֥וֹת הַבְּרִֽית׃
pairs.english: that the L-rd gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.

pairs.hebrew: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י ק֣וּם רֵ֤ד מַהֵר֙ מִזֶּ֔ה
pairs.english: And the L-rd said to me: Arise, descend quickly hence.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצֵ֖אתָ מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם
pairs.english: For the people that you took out of Egypt have corrupted themselves.

pairs.hebrew: סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן־הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔ם עָשׂ֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם מַסֵּכָֽה׃
pairs.english: They have turned quickly from the way that I commanded them; they have made a molten image.
And the L-rd said to me:

pairs.hebrew: רָאִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה עַם־קְשֵׁה־עֹ֖רֶף הֽוּא׃
pairs.english: I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiff-necked people.

pairs.hebrew: הֶ֤רֶף מִמֶּ֙נִּי֙ וְאַשְׁמִידֵ֔ם וְאֶמְחֶ֣ה אֶת־שְׁמָ֔ם מִתַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם
pairs.english: Quit Me and I shall destroy them, and I shall erase their name from beneath the heavens,
and I shall make you a nation mightier and more numerous than they.

pairs.hebrew: וָאֵ֗פֶן וָֽאֵרֵד֙ מִן־הָהָ֔ר וְהָהָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּאֵ֑שׁ
pairs.english: And I turned, and I went down from the mountain. And the mountain burned in fire,

pairs.hebrew: וּשְׁנֵי֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הַבְּרִ֔ית עַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י יָדָֽי׃
pairs.english: and the two tablets of stone on my two hands.

pairs.hebrew: וָאֵ֗רֶא וְהִנֵּ֤ה חֲטָאתֶם֙ לַיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָכֶ֔ם עֵ֖גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה
pairs.english: And I saw, and, behold, you had sinned against the L-rd your G-d; you had made for yourselves a molten calf.

pairs.hebrew: סַרְתֶּ֣ם מַהֵ֔ר מִן־הַדֶּ֕רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃
pairs.english: You had turned quickly from the way that the L-rd had commanded you.

pairs.hebrew: וָאֶתְפֹּשׂ֙ בִּשְׁנֵ֣י הַלֻּחֹ֔ת וָֽאַשְׁלִכֵ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדָ֑י
pairs.english: And I took hold of the two tablets and I cast them from my two hands,
and I broke them before your eyes.

pairs.hebrew: וָֽאֶתְנַפַּל֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהֹוָ֜ה כָּרִאשֹׁנָ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְאַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה
pairs.english: And I prostrated myself before the L-rd as at first (see Exodus 33:30), forty days and forty nights.

pairs.hebrew: לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔לְתִּי וּמַ֖יִם לֹ֣א שָׁתִ֑יתִי
pairs.english: Bread I did not eat, and water I did not drink,

pairs.hebrew: עַ֤ל כׇּל־חַטַּאתְכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲטָאתֶ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֛ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לְהַכְעִיסֽוֹ׃
pairs.english: because of all your sins wherein you had sinned, to do the evil in the eyes of the L-rd to anger Him.

pairs.hebrew: כִּ֣י יָגֹ֗רְתִּי מִפְּנֵ֤י הָאַף֙ וְהַ֣חֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָצַ֧ף יְהֹוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם לְהַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְכֶ֑ם
pairs.english: For I was affrighted before the anger and the wrath wherein the L-rd was wroth against you to destroy you.

pairs.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י גַּ֖ם בַּפַּ֥עַם הַהִֽוא׃
pairs.english: And the L-rd hearkened to me at that time too.
And against Aaron was the L-rd extremely wroth, [(for having heeded them)], to destroy him [(This connotes the killing of his children)],
and I prayed also on Aaron's behalf at that time [(and my prayer availed to atone for half, two of his sons remaining alive)].

pairs.hebrew: וְֽאֶת־חַטַּאתְכֶ֞ם אֲשֶׁר־עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אֶת־הָעֵ֗גֶל לָקַ֘חְתִּי֮ וָאֶשְׂרֹ֣ף אֹת֣וֹ ׀ בָּאֵשׁ֒
pairs.english: And your sin that you wrought — the calf — I took it and I burnt it in fire,

pairs.hebrew: וָאֶכֹּ֨ת אֹת֤וֹ טָחוֹן֙ הֵיטֵ֔ב עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־דַּ֖ק לְעָפָ֑ר
pairs.english: and I crushed it, grinding it down, until it was thin as dust.
And I cast its dust into the stream that ran down from the mountain.
